Geometric Large-Deviation-Type Principles for Mixed Measures
abstractText: Abstract We study a geometric analogue of the large deviation principle for mixed measures associated with a class of $$\log $$ log -concave probability measures whose densities depend on the gauge of a convex body. For convex bodies in $$\mathbb {R}^n$$ R n , we prove a geometric large-deviation-type asymptotic for first-order mixed measures, in which the decay under dilation is governed by a natural inradius associated with the measure. In the planar case, we derive an explicit representation and prove a genuine logarithmic limit for second-order mixed measures. As an application, we prove a comparison theorem showing that asymptotic dominance under dilation forces inclusion between convex bodies.

The Free Energy of the Square Lattice Ising Model with Interactions Alternating in Horizontal and Vertical Directions
abstractText: The free energy of the Ising model on the square lattice with alternating interactions in both horizontal and vertical directions is exactly derived. This model is distinct from the checkerboard Ising model. The result includes Onsager’s free energy as a special case, and also includes Lee–Yang’s free energy with an imaginary field, and relates these two solutions via continuous parameters. The result includes a generalization of Lee–Yang’s result to cases with four different couplings. It is also derived that each imaginary magnetic field iπ/2 applied to a lattice site corresponds to a single frustrated square in its dual lattice.

Methodological challenges, solution pathways, and future priorities in Mendelian randomization research: a bibliometric and content analysis
abstractText: Objective To characterize the global landscape, intellectual structure, major methodological challenges, dominant solution pathways, and future priorities in Mendelian randomization (MR) research. Methods Articles and reviews on MR within the predefined 2003–2025 eligibility window were retrieved from the Web of Science Core Collection (WOSCC) and Scopus to construct a primary corpus (A-corpus). After field harmonization and hierarchical deduplication, conventional bibliometric analyses were performed. A problem-driven B-corpus was constructed by applying a prespecified terminology dictionary to titles, abstracts, and keywords, followed by manual eligibility review of dictionary-positive records and independent double coding across four dimensions: methodological challenges, solution pathways, future priorities, and solution orientations. Results The A-corpus comprised 21,346 publications retrieved under the predefined 2003–2025 eligibility window; a small number of eligible records carried 2026 early-access or indexing metadata in the source databases. Strict dictionary screening identified 10,598 candidate records; 10,291 were excluded after eligibility review and 307 publications were retained in the final B-corpus. In the B-corpus, horizontal pleiotropy was the most frequent methodological challenge (90/307, 29.3%), mixed sensitivity framework was the dominant solution pathway (107/307, 34.9%), and reproducible reporting pipeline (45/307, 14.7%), mechanism-aware inference (36/307, 11.7%), and omics integration (34/307, 11.1%) were the leading explicitly coded future-priority categories. Inter-coder reliability ranged from moderate to almost perfect across dimensions, with Cohen’s kappa values of 0.434 for methodological challenges, 0.531 for solution pathways, 0.703 for future priorities, and 0.897 for solution orientations. Conclusion This combined bibliometric and content analysis identified major publication patterns, recurrent methodological challenges, commonly reported solution pathways, and explicitly stated future priorities in MR research. The findings show the continuing prominence of causal-validity concerns alongside attention to mechanistic interpretation, reproducibility, generalizability, and translation; they describe patterns in the published literature rather than establishing the comparative scientific validity or clinical value of individual MR methods.

title: Optimizing cross-border CCS policy: an integrated energy–carbon–cost framework for source–host credit allocation
abstractText: Cross-border carbon capture and storage (CCS) can support industrial decarbonisation where emissions and storage resources are unevenly distributed. Existing optimisation studies mainly minimise techno-economic cost and rarely integrate energy penalties, country-level emissions accounting, domestic-versus-export allocation, and source–host credit sharing. This study develops a mixed-integer linear programming framework that selects domestic or export storage, shipping routes, offshore pipelines, and sinks while tracking operational emissions, costs, and source–host credit allocation. An anonymised Japan–Malaysia case includes two Japanese sources, two Malaysian sinks, and a domestic screening pathway. Domestic Japanese storage costs USD 0.327 billion/year, compared with USD 0.484 billion/year for full export. Under the Combined Competitiveness scenario, a combination of a lower Malaysian service fee, equal source–host credit sharing, and an upper-end published domestic-storage cost selects full export to MY-Sink 1 at USD 0.426 billion/year, with the capability of storing 2.674 MtCO2/year after shipping loss. Credit ownership changes economic and national accounting outcomes without changing routing. Malaysian storage and injection, shipping, and credit values give the largest local sensitivity responses. In summary, the framework provides a transparent method for assessing cross-border CCS competitiveness, operational emissions, and sink selection.

title: Creating and Sustaining the Judgement Space: Professional Judgement and Dialogic Inquiry in AI-Supported Higher Education
abstractText: Abstract Professional judgement, the situated, normative practice of weighing what is educationally desirable rather than merely technically effective, is central to educational professionalism. Yet international frameworks for faculty development converge on what individual faculty should know and do, without conceptualising the conditions under which professional judgement is exercised, or how AI restructures them. This paper introduces the judgement space: the pedagogical condition within which professional judgement is not only exercised but articulated, examined, and sustained through pedagogical interaction. In AI-supported higher education, where students engage with AI independently and beyond the pedagogical relationship, the judgement space becomes a three-party condition: AI-generated evaluative outputs enter the interaction alongside the judgement of teacher and student. We draw on Biesta’s account of educational purpose across qualification, socialisation, and subjectification. From this account, we advance three claims. First, professional judgement is foundational to faculty development, not reducible to one competency among many. Second, AI restructures the evidence base on which professional judgement operates. It captures qualification-domain evidence more readily than evidence of socialisation and subjectification, privileging responsive practice unless the pedagogical framework positions AI to enrich rather than impoverish the judgement space. Third, the dialogic inquiry triangle, developed within the dialogic inquiry tradition and examined in school-based practitioner research, provides such a framework. Extended to AI-supported higher education, it structures the three-party interaction through which the judgement space can be created and sustained. We derive six structural principles for the teacher-student-AI interaction and a professional judgement audit for faculty development.

title: Communication-Centric Security Models for Mobile Digital Learning Systems
abstractText: The fast penetration of mobile digital learning systems has further enhanced high dependency on the heterogeneous wireless communication network, which poses strong security issues pertaining mobility, dynamic nature of traffic and continuity of real-time sessions. Traditional security infrastructures are largely application-oriented, and take on a static form, which cannot be suitable in both latency sensitive and mobility-based learning environment. The paper suggests a communication-based security model of mobile digital learning systems, where the security enforcement is closely coupled with dynamics of the communication layer. An adaptive communication algorithm that is security-conscious is created to dynamically change the decisions of authentication, encryption and secure handover decisions in response to network conditions, mobility patterns and perceived threat levels. The suggested model is tested with the use of extensive simulation with different learner densities, mobility speeds and attack cases. The evaluation of performance is based on a set of security metrics comprising of authentication success rate, attack mitigation rate, and secure session establishment time, and communication metrics, such as end-to-end latency, throughput, and packet delivery ratio, and handover delay. The comparison of the results with the results of a static and rule-based security schemes proves that the proposed approach is significantly better in improving the communication reliability and security robustness, with low latency and manageable overhead. These results emphasise the power of the communication-based security model as a comparable and viable approach to secure mobile digital learning in upcoming wireless networks of the next generation.

title: Implementasi Pendekatan Komunikatif pada Mata Kuliah Muhadatsah Mahasiswa Prodi Pendidikan Bahasa Arab STAI Al-Gazali Soppeng
abstractText: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mendeskripsikan implementasi pendekatan komunikatif dalam pembelajaran Muhadatsah serta dampaknya terhadap kemampuan berbicara mahasiswa Program Studi Pendidikan Bahasa Arab STAI Al-Gazali Soppeng. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif deskriptif dengan subjek mahasiswa yang mengikuti mata kuliah Muhadatsah. Teknik pengumpulan data meliputi observasi, wawancara, dan dokumentasi, sedangkan analisis data dilakukan melalui tahapan reduksi data, penyajian data, dan penarikan kesimpulan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa pendekatan komunikatif diimplementasikan melalui berbagai aktivitas berbasis komunikasi, seperti dialog, diskusi kelompok, bermain peran, dan simulasi percakapan kontekstual. Pendekatan ini mampu menciptakan suasana pembelajaran yang komunikatif dan partisipatif, meningkatkan keberanian, kelancaran, serta kepercayaan diri mahasiswa dalam berbicara bahasa Arab. Selain itu, pendekatan komunikatif juga berdampak positif terhadap motivasi dan keaktifan mahasiswa serta mendorong perubahan peran dosen sebagai fasilitator pembelajaran. Dengan demikian, pendekatan komunikatif dinilai efektif dalam meningkatkan kualitas pembelajaran Muhadatsah dan kompetensi komunikatif mahasiswa dalam keterampilan berbicara bahasa Arab.

abstractText: يهدف هذا المقال إلى تقديم شرحًا نظريًا تفصيليًا لآلية اشتقاق أسماء الفاعل المَزيدة في لهجة مدينة المَرْج الليبية من اللهجة البَرْقاوية، مع تركيز خاص على الحالات التي تكون فيها عملية الاشتقاق صعبة. في اللغة العربية، تُبْنَى أسماء الفاعل من الصيغتين الثانية والثالثة بأسلوب واضح من خلال إدراج البادئة /م/ مضمومة، والتي يمكن أن ينتج عنها صِيَغ مِثْل مُكَسِّر ومُسَاعِد. أما لهجة مدينة المرج، فتُظْهِر اختلافًا كبيرًا في هذا الوزن الصَرْفيّ، حيث يُحْذَف الصوت القصير (الضمة) في بداية الكلمة غالبا لينتج عنه التقاء السواكن في بداية الكلمة (مثلا: مكسر). هذا النوع من التقاء صوت رنان وآخر انحِباسي لا يُقْبَل به في لهجة المرج بسبب قواعد التلاقي الصوتي. وبناءً على ذلك، تُدْرَج الحركة المحايدة (الشوا) في بداية الكلمة لتُكَوِّن الصيغة (امْكسر). تُعَدُّ عملية الاشتقاق (ديوك يورك) هذه مثالا على عدم الشفافية الصوتية الناتجة عن منع تطبيق القاعدة الصوتية، والتي تُمَثِّل تحديًا لموازاة نظرية المفاضلة. استنادًا إلى نظرية المفاضلة الطبقية، يَتناول المقال هذا الغموض الصوتي أو عدم الشفافية الصوتية باستخدام ثلاثة مستويات من قواعد تصنيف الصوت: مستوى الجِذْع الذي يحمي البِنْيَة الصرفية، ومستوى الكلمة الذي يدعم حذف الصوت الصائت (الحركة)، ومستوى التركيب (الجملة) الذي يتطلب إدراج صوت صائت لإصلاح الالتقاء الغير مسموح به. تُسْهِم الدراسة الحالية في فهم أفضل للغموض الاشتقاقي، دور وزن المقطع الصوتي، والتفاعل بين علم الصرف وعلم الصوتيات في اللغات السامية.

Forensic practitioners’ perspectives on the feasibility and acceptability of implementing dog-based animal-assisted interventions in Scottish custodial and forensic mental health settings: a qualitative study
abstractText: Abstract Background Mental health difficulties are common among people in Scottish prisons. Although animal-assisted interventions (AAIs) have been associated with a range of psychological and social benefits, these interventions are not routinely embedded within custodial care. Little is known about forensic practitioners’ experiences and perceptions of dog-based AAIs across Scottish prisons and secure forensic mental health services. This qualitative study explored the perspectives of 15 forensic practitioners working in Scottish custodial and forensic mental health settings. Participation was open to practitioners with direct experience of incorporating or delivering dog-based AAIs and to those with relevant forensic practice or implementation knowledge. Semi-structured interviews explored practitioners’ perceptions of the acceptability, feasibility, benefits and challenges of delivering dog-based AAIs in custodial and forensic mental health settings. Data were analysed using inductive reflexive thematic analysis within a contextualist framework. Results Practitioners associated dog-based AAIs with a calmer interpersonal atmosphere characterised by emotional settling, non-judgemental connection, disclosure and more constructive group interaction. Some practitioners described or anticipated brief relief from occupational strain among staff and linked direct observation of sessions with greater willingness to support delivery. Practitioners generally regarded the sessions as acceptable to people receiving them. Staff acceptance was more variable and appeared to be shaped by direct experience and perceptions of legitimacy. Feasibility was described as fragile, with delivery dependent on staffing and the stability of daily routines. Practitioners also emphasised the importance of appropriate training, sustainable funding, animal welfare safeguards and careful management of endings. Conclusions Practitioners, most of whom had direct experience of implementing dog-based AAIs, viewed these interventions as having the potential to support health and well-being within custodial and forensic mental health services when delivery was supported by stable operational arrangements and robust welfare safeguards. Future research should include the perspectives of people receiving dog-based AAIs to examine whether the changes described by practitioners extend beyond individual sessions.

title: Tantangan Etika Akademik dalam Penggunaan Kecerdasan Buatan pada Penulisan Karya Ilmiah Mahasiswa
abstractText: Penggunaan kecerdasan buatan (artificial intelligence/AI) generatif seperti ChatGPT semakin meluas dalam penulisan karya ilmiah mahasiswa dan menghadirkan tantangan baru bagi etika akademik. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mendeskripsikan bentuk tantangan etika yang muncul ketika AI digunakan dalam penulisan karya ilmiah mahasiswa, faktor yang melatarbelakanginya, serta upaya penguatan etika akademik. Penelitian menggunakan metode kualitatif deskriptif dengan teknik studi literatur terhadap 15 artikel relevan yang terbit pada tahun 2023 sampai 2026. Hasil kajian menunjukkan bahwa tantangan utama meliputi risiko plagiarisme dan ketidakjujuran akademik, keengganan mengungkapkan penggunaan AI, penyalinan hasil AI tanpa evaluasi kritis, ketergantungan yang melemahkan kemandirian menulis, serta kaburnya batas kepengarangan. Tantangan tersebut dipengaruhi oleh belum adanya pedoman penggunaan AI yang jelas, terbatasnya literasi etika dan literasi informasi, serta tekanan akademik. Etika akademik dapat diperkuat melalui pedoman institusi yang jelas, edukasi dan pelatihan etika penggunaan AI, keteladanan dosen, dan pembiasaan transparansi dalam penggunaan AI. Oleh karena itu, mahasiswa perlu dibekali kesadaran etis agar AI tetap menjadi alat bantu, bukan pengganti proses berpikir dan menulis mereka sendiri.

title: Application of Coconut Shell Activated Carbon for the Adsorption of Toxic Heavy Metals from Wastewater
abstractText: Copper and lead are poisonous, non-biodegradable heavy metals that persist in the environment and can cause severe health challenges in the human body. This study investigates the effectiveness of coconut shell activated carbon (CSAC) as an adsorbent for the removal of copper and lead ions from wastewater in a batch mode. The effects of varying operating parameters in the adsorption process namely, initial concentration (10–200 mg/L), pH (2–12), adsorbent dosage (1–5 g) and particle size (75–300 µm) using the central composite design (CCD). The adsorbent was characterised prior to and after adsorption to determine the functional groups, morphological structure and the elemental composition with the aid of Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR), Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS) analytical instruments respectively. The analysis of variance (ANOVA) indicated a strong coefficient of determination (R2) for Cu2+ and Pb2+, measuring 0.9761 and 0.9689, respectively. Adsorption of Pb2+ showed higher capacity and stronger affinity than Cu2⁺. Isotherm studies showed that the Langmuir, Temkin, and Dubinin–Radushkevich (D–R) models provided a strong fit for Pb2+ but were significantly less suitable for describing the Cu2+ adsorption data. while kinetics followed pseudo-second order, confirming chemisorption. This research aids in the application of commercial activated carbon derived from coconut shell for treating water contaminated with copper and lead metal ions.

Analisa Kinerja Jaringan Irigasi dengan Pendekatan IKSI di Daerah Irigasi Rolak Songo (Studi Kasus : Saluran Sekunder Cepiples)
abstractText: Irrigation networks play an important role in supporting agricultural productivity and ensuring the smooth distribution of water to agricultural land. However, the Cepiples Secondary Canal in the Rolak Songo Irrigation Area still faces several problems, including canal damage, sedimentation, uncontrolled vegetation growth, and suboptimal performance of irrigation supporting structures, which may affect the overall performance of the network. These conditions indicate the need for a comprehensive evaluation of the irrigation network to determine its performance level and maintenance requirements. This study aims to analyze the performance of the irrigation network using the Irrigation System Performance Index (IKSI) approach based on Minister of Public Works and Housing Regulation Number 12/PRT/M/2015 and to identify the required maintenance and improvement measures. The research employed a quantitative descriptive method through field surveys, observations, interviews, documentation, and secondary data collection from relevant institutions. The assessment covered six main aspects: physical infrastructure, cropping productivity, supporting facilities, organization and personnel, documentation, and Water User Farmers Association (P3A) institutions. The results show that the overall irrigation network performance is categorized as good. The average scores were 82.28% for physical infrastructure, 85.22% for cropping productivity, 83.63% for supporting facilities, 89.91% for organization and personnel, 82.63% for documentation, and 75.89% for P3A institutions. The evaluation indicates that the irrigation network remains functional in supporting irrigation water distribution and agricultural land services. Nevertheless, several components still require maintenance and improvement, particularly supporting facilities and P3A institutional aspects, to maintain network performance and ensure effective and sustainable irrigation services.

Choosing Cardiovascular Assessment and Risk-Prediction Tools Across the Care Pathway
abstractText: Cardiovascular diseases remain a leading cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide, making accurate and efficient risk stratification essential across the care pathway. Numerous tools support emergency triage, disease assessment, procedural decision-making, long-term prevention, atrial fibrillation management, and evaluation of functional status, but no single model is applicable across all clinical settings or populations. This clinician-oriented review categorizes and critically compares commonly used cardiovascular assessment and risk-prediction tools, including History, Electrocardiogram, Age, Risk factors, Troponin, Global Registry of Acute Coronary Events, and Thrombolysis in Myocardial Infarction for emergency triage; Agatston, Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis, and Synergy Between Percutaneous Coronary Intervention with Taxus and Cardiac Surgery for anatomical and clinical assessment; European System for Cardiac Operative Risk Evaluation, Society of Thoracic Surgeons, and Revised Cardiac Risk Index, for procedural risk; and Framingham, the pooled cohort equations implemented in the Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease, Risk Estimator, Systematic Coronary Risk Evaluation 2, QResearch Cardiovascular Risk Algorithm 3, and Predicting Risk of Cardiovascular Disease EVENTs for long-term prediction. Congestive heart failure, hypertension, age ≥75, diabetes, stroke/transient ischemic attack (2 points), congestive heart failure, hypertension, age ≥75 (2 points), diabetes, stroke/TIA (2 points), vascular disease, age 65–74, sex category (female), and hypertension, abnormal renal/liver function, stroke, bleeding history, labile international normalized ratio, elderly, drugs/alcohol, are discussed in the context of atrial fibrillation, alongside New York Heart Association and the Seattle Angina Questionnaire as measures of functional status and quality of life. For each tool, we examine its clinical purpose, principal variables, strengths, limitations, practical applications, and areas of overlap. Differences in implementation across healthcare systems and patient populations are considered to support context-appropriate selection. Persistent limitations include poor standardization, reliance on data that may be unavailable in resource-constrained settings, limited transportability, and incomplete integration into clinical workflows. Greater harmonization, external validation, digital automation, and the careful incorporation of biomarkers and artificial intelligence may support more accessible, dynamic, and personalized cardiovascular risk assessment.

title: Application Of E-Servqual In Analyzing The Quality Of Online Food Ordering Services In The Gojek Application
abstractText: PT Gojek Indonesia is a transportation service company that is currently very popular among the public. As a well-known online transportation platform in Indonesia, Gojek is naturally expected by many customers to deliver high-quality service and performance. However, many customers have been disappointed because the service and performance did not meet their expectations. Customer reviews of Gojek, particularly regarding GoFood orders, indicate that the service quality of the Gojek application still needs to be improved. Therefore, this study aims to prevent errors between merchants and drivers when picking up food for customers and to improve Gojek's service quality. The research method used in this study is the E-Servqual method, analyzed through five dimensions: Reliability, Responsiveness, Assurance, Empathy, and Tangibles. The gap results show that GoFood's service quality on all five dimensions has not yet met customer expectations; therefore, GoFood management needs to make improvements in some of these dimensions.

title: DARI KARISMA MENUJU KOMUNIO
abstractText: Penelitian ini mendekonstruksi model kepemimpinan Kristen yang terperangkap dalam paradigma karismatik-individualis dan merekonstruksinya menuju model komunal yang berakar pada teologi Trinitas. Krisis kepemimpinan kontemporer bukan hanya praktis tetapi ontologis: pemimpin dipahami sebagai subjek otonom yang memiliki karisma dan otoritas dalam dirinya sendiri—asumsi yang bertentangan dengan hakikat Gereja sebagai komunio. Menggunakan pendekatan kritis-konstruktif dengan metode studi kepustakaan, penelitian ini menganalisis karya utama Jean-Luc Nancy (Being Singular Plural, The Inoperative Community) dan eklesiologi komunio John D. Zizioulas (Being as Communion). Hasilnya menunjukkan bahwa filsafat Nancy, terutama konsep being singular plural dan inoperative community, membongkar mitos "pemimpin karismatik" dengan menunjukkan bahwa being selalu sudah being-with-one-another dan otoritas adalah efek relasional dari pengakuan komunitas. Sementara itu, teologi Trinitas menawarkan fondasi ontologis melalui perikoresis, di mana kepemimpinan adalah representasi otoritas Kristus yang melayani. Dari dialog kritis ini dirumuskan model "Kepemimpinan Komunal" dengan karakteristik: non-substantial, perikoretis, partisipatif, an-arkis, dan eskatologis. Penelitian ini menyimpulkan bahwa kepemimpinan Kristen bukan tentang memiliki karisma pribadi, tetapi menjadi saksi komunio Allah—sebuah gerakan dari karisma menuju komunio.

Household Water Sources, Accessibility and Consumption Patterns in Selected Rural Communities of Taraba State, Nigeria
abstractText: Rural water insecurity remains a persistent development challenge in Nigeria, particularly in communities with limited access to reliable water infrastructure. This study assessed water supply, household water consumption patterns, and factors influencing water use in ten rural communities of Taraba State, northeastern Nigeria. The communities were purposively selected based on their rural characteristics and varying access to functional water infrastructure, after which households were sampled systematically. A cross-sectional household survey was conducted among 500 respondents, producing allocations ranging from 40 to 62 respondents in each community. Data were collected using structured questionnaires and analysed using descriptive statistics, Pearson correlation, and multiple linear regression. Results showed that rivers and streams were the principal sources of domestic water (39.0%), followed by rainwater harvesting (34.0%) and hand-dug wells (23.4%), while only 3.6% of households used private or public boreholes. Distance to water source, collection time, and water cost were negatively associated with household water consumption, whereas household income and household size showed positive associations. The regression model explained 53.4% of the variation in household water consumption (adjusted R² = 0.529; p < 0.001). Distance to the water source had the largest absolute standardised regression coefficient in the reported model (β = −0.396). However, distance, collection time, income and other categorical or range-based variables were represented using numerical codes for ordered categories; therefore, coefficients should be interpreted as associations with coded categories rather than necessarily as effects per continuous unit. The findings highlight physical accessibility, affordability and socioeconomic conditions as important dimensions of rural water insecurity and underscore the need for improved water infrastructure and maintenance.

abstractText: Penelitian ini bertujuan merekonstruksi ulang makna awal teologi Sabat berdasarkan narasi penciptaan, serta perkembangan Sabat pada saat pemberian Hukum Taurat, dan pada masa kehidupan Yesus. Penelitian ini juga bertujuan untuk menemukan makna kerja dan istirahat yang dimaksudkan Allah pada hari Sabat. Kajian ini dilatarbelakangi oleh pemahaman umum yang cenderung memaknai Sabat sebagai larangan bekerja, kewajiban beristirahat atau kewajiban beribadah, sehingga dimensi teologis yang mendasarinya sering kali tidak sesuai pada makna awalnya. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode kualitatif dengan pendekatan narasi biblika terhadap Kejadian 2:1–3, Keluaran 20:8–11, serta narasi konflik Sabat dalam konteks masyarakat Yahudi abad pertama (Mat. 12:15a). Analisis dilakukan melalui penelaahan untuk menelusuri asal mula teologi Sabat dari penciptaan hingga pelayanan Yesus. Hasil penelitian ini menunjukkan bahwa makna Sabat pada mulanya tidak dimaksudkan sebagai penghentian aktivitas kerja, melainkan sebagai ekspresi perkenanan Allah terhadap ciptaan yang telah mencapai kondisi yang sesuai dengan maksud-Nya. Namun, keadaan tersebut berubah setelah kejatuhan manusia ke dalam dosa yang mengakibatkan rusaknya pada tatanan ciptaan sebelumnya. Dalam konteks ini, kondisi yang menjadi dasar Sabat atau istirahat Allah dipandang mengalami kerusakan karena ciptaan tidak lagi berada dalam keadaan yang dinyatakan “sungguh amat baik.” Penelitian ini juga menemukan bahwa konflik Sabat pada masa Yesus muncul ketika penekanan terhadap makna Sabat berdampak pada regulasi pekerjaan sehingga menggeser tujuan teologis Sabat yang semula. title: Synthesis, Characterization, and Antibacterial Efficacy of Cu-ZIF-8: In Vitro Study of Multidrug-Resistant Gram-Positive and Gram-Negative Bacteria
abstractText: Recently, Staphylococcus aureus and Pseudomonas aeruginosa have become multidrug-resistant (MDR) and produce many virulence factors, posing a health risk. Therefore, addressing knowledge gaps and finding solutions to the challenge caused by bacteria's increased resistance to multiple antibiotics is an urgent need. To address this risk, we aim to synthesize new nanoparticles with long-lasting, safe effects and low toxicity. Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) are promising materials with high efficiency in inhibiting or killing MDR bacteria. In this investigation, we successfully synthesized copper-doped ZIF-8 (Cu-ZIF-8) nanocomposites using the solvothermal method. Its characteristics were studied using techniques like SEM, FTIR, EDX, and XRD. The Cu-ZIF-8-MOF exhibited high antibacterial efficacy against S. aureus (Gram-positive) and P. aeruginosa (Gram-negative), with concentrations of 12.5, 25, 50, and 100 μg/mL showing high efficiency against P. aeruginosa. In contrast, it was less effective against S. aureus. These results open up wide prospects for the application of the Cu-ZIF-8-MOF antimicrobial agent.

abstractText: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis pengelolaan sumber daya manusia gereja di konteks jemaat berpendidikan rendah, dengan fokus pada tantangan, strategi adaptif, dan peran kepemimpinan dalam pembinaan iman jemaat. Data dianalisis menggunakan model analisis tematik Braun dan Clarke untuk menemukan pola makna dan tema utama. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa rendahnya tingkat pendidikan berdampak pada partisipasi jemaat, kemandirian pelayanan, dan regenerasi kepemimpinan. Namun, gereja mampu mengembangkan strategi pastoral adaptif berbasis kasih, relasi personal, dan keteladanan hidup pelayan. Kepemimpinan transformatif terbukti menjadi kunci pembinaan yang efektif, sementara gereja berperan semakin luas sebagai agen pemberdayaan sosial dan literasi iman. Kesimpulannya, pendidikan iman nonformal, keteladanan rohani, dan pembinaan relasional merupakan pilar utama dalam membangun gereja yang mandiri, kontekstual, dan berdaya di tengah keterbatasan sosial jemaat pedesaan.

abstractText: งานวิจัยนี้มีวัตถุประสงค์เพื่อศึกษาพฤติกรรมการใช้น้ำ วิเคราะห์ความสัมพันธ์ทางชลศาสตร์ และพัฒนาแบบจำลองโครงข่ายท่อประปาเพื่อเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพการบริหารจัดการน้ำ ผลการศึกษาพฤติกรรมการใช้น้ำทั้ง 9 โซน พบรูปแบบการใช้น้ำสูงสุดแบ่งเป็น 5 ลักษณะหลัก โดยกลุ่มอาคารเรียนและสำนักงานมีปริมาณการใช้สูงสุดช่วงพักเปลี่ยนคาบเรียน สอดคล้องกับหอพักนิสิตที่ใช้สูงสุดช่วงเช้า ส่งผลให้หอถังสูงมีอัตราการจ่ายน้ำสูงสุดเป็นช่วงกว้างตามกลุ่มดังกล่าว ขณะที่พื้นที่สีเขียวเน้นการใช้น้ำช่วงเย็น และกลุ่มโรงอาหารกับสถานพยาบาลมีการใช้น้ำต่อเนื่องตลอดวัน สำหรับการวิเคราะห์ความสัมพันธ์ระหว่างมาตรวัดน้ำ 10 แห่ง และเกจวัดแรงดัน 7 เครื่อง ที่ไม่ทราบขอบเขตผู้ใช้น้ำที่แน่ชัดด้วยสมการถดถอยเชิงเส้น (linear regression) จากข้อมูลภาคสนาม 62 ชุด พบว่ามี 5 ตำแหน่ง ที่อัตราการใช้น้ำและแรงดันน้ำมีความสัมพันธ์เชิงลบอย่างมีนัยสำคัญทางสถิติ (p<0.05) สอดคล้องกับพฤติกรรมทางไฮดรอลิกในเส้นท่อเดียวกัน ส่วนอีก 5 ตำแหน่งไม่มีนัยสำคัญทางสถิติ (p>0.05) ในด้านการพัฒนาแบบจำลองด้วยโปรแกรม EPANET การสอบเทียบครั้งที่ 1 ให้ค่าสัมประสิทธิ์สหสัมพันธ์เฉลี่ยทั้งระบบสูงถึง 0.89 และการสอบเทียบครั้งที่ 2 ภายใต้สภาวะคงตัว ให้ค่า MAPE ต่ำเพียง 4.29 เปอร์เซ็นต์ และความคลาดเคลื่อนแรงดันเฉลี่ย 1.68 เมตร ยืนยันความแม่นยำของแบบจำลองในระดับดีมาก ทั้งนี้ งานวิจัยได้เสนอแนะให้หน่วยงานปรับปรุงฐานข้อมูลโครงข่ายร่วมกับระบบภูมิสารสนเทศ (GIS) และติดตั้งระบบตรวจวัดระยะไกล (telemetry) เพื่อให้แบบจำลองสามารถนำไปประยุกต์ใช้ในการควบคุมและลดปริมาณน้ำสูญเสียในระบบ สนับสนุนการบริหารจัดการน้ำอย่างยั่งยืนต่อไป

Impact Of Tiktok Review Overclaim On Consumer Trust and Repurchase Intention Of Generation Z
abstractText: This paper provides an empirical investigation intothe impact of promotional overclaims in TikTokvideo reviews on consumer trust and repurchaseintention among Generation Z undergraduatestudents. Grounded in Source Credibility Theory andExpectancy Disconfirmation Theory, a quantitative causal research design was implemented. Primarydata were gathered through a structured onlinequestionnaire administered to 100 activeundergraduate students in the Digital Business study program at Universitas Kristen Satya Wacana who had experienced product discrepancies following purchases driven by TikTok reviews. Data analysiswas executed using simple linear regressionmodeling in IBM SPSS Statistics. The empirical findings demonstrated that promotional overclaimsin TikTok video reviews exerted a statisticallysignificant negative influence on consumer trust (B =0.868, t = 16.406, p = 0.000), accounting for 73.3 percent of the variance in consumer trust erosion. Furthermore, review overclaims exerted a statistically significant negative impact on repurchase intention (B = 0.918, t = 17.765, p =0.000), explaining 76.3 percent of the variance inrepurchase reluctance. Descriptive statisticalanalyses revealed high mean scores for perceivedoverclaim (4.196), consumer skepticism (4.056), andrepurchase reluctance (4.178). These findings confirm that deceptive promotional exaggerations severely damage creator credibility and long-termbrand equity in social commerce environments.Consequently, content creators must prioritizeobjective transparency, social commerce platformsshould implement stringent disclosure tags, andyoung consumers should exercise criticalverification before making purchasing decisionsbased on short video content.

title: Strategi Pengembangan Daerah Pangkal Perlawanan dalam Mendukung Pertahanan Pulau-Pulau Besar dan Gugusan Pulau Strategis
abstractText: Indonesia memerlukan pendekatan pertahanan kewilayahan yang menghubungkan postur pertahanan pulau-pulau besar dengan kesiapan wilayah dan ketahanan masyarakat. Penelitian ini menganalisis strategi pengembangan Daerah Pangkal Perlawanan (DPP) untuk mendukung pertahanan pulau-pulau besar dan gugusan pulau strategis. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan desain studi kasus; data diperoleh melalui wawancara mendalam terhadap 10 informan kunci, observasi, studi dokumentasi, dan focus group discussion, kemudian dianalisis dengan NVivo 14 melalui pengodean tematik, matrix coding query, analisis hierarki, dan cluster analysis hingga menghasilkan 567 referensi terkode pada lima tema. Skor kesiapan DPP rata-rata sebesar 2,97 dari 5, dengan Jawa tertinggi (3,56) dan Papua terendah (2,40). Keterbatasan infrastruktur (seluruh informan), koordinasi lintas sektor (90%), dan anggaran (80%) menjadi hambatan utama, sedangkan posisi geografis strategis (100%), sumber daya alam (90%), dan dukungan kebijakan pertahanan (80%) menjadi pendorong utama. Analisis klaster menunjukkan kemiripan pengodean yang kuat antara kebijakan, kelembagaan, dan Kogabwilhan, serta antara infrastruktur, koordinasi, dan anggaran. Artikel mengusulkan lima pilar strategi: regulasi, infrastruktur pendukung, sumber daya manusia dan komponen cadangan, tata kelola kelembagaan, serta pemberdayaan masyarakat. DPP perlu dikelola sebagai sistem pertahanan kewilayahan yang terintegrasi, bertahap, dan akuntabel sesuai karakteristik wilayah.

title: The Bag Is Not Always Bad: Intrahospital Spread of 2-Step Urinary Tract Infection Screening
abstractText: OBJECTIVES Urine cultures are frequently collected in hospitalized children for urinary tract infection (UTI) screening, despite often being unnecessary, invasive, and resource intensive. We aimed to decrease the proportion of unnecessary urine cultures in admitted children aged 90 days to 24 months from 65% to 45% over 1 year. METHODOLOGY The Model for Improvement guided problem understanding and change ideas. The main intervention included a 2-step UTI screening pathway previously implemented at our institution’s emergency department with emphasis on completing point-of-care urinalysis (UA) on noninvasive urine bag sample. If positive for pyuria, bladder catheterization was performed for urine culture. Additional interventions included electronic medical record order set, education, interdisciplinary collaboration, and alignment with the institution’s Choosing Wisely program. The primary outcome was the proportion of urine cultures completed without preceding positive UA screen. The balancing measure was the number of missed UTIs. Analysis used Statistical Process Control charts. RESULTS Baseline data (April 2020-March 2021) demonstrated that 65% of urine cultures were collected without a preceding positive UA. Postintervention data (April 2021-January 2025) demonstrated a decreased proportion of urine cultures collected without preceding positive UA screen from 65% to 22%. Special cause variation was detected 1 year following implementation of the pathway with sustained change during the study period. There was no increase in missed UTIs. CONCLUSIONS Process standardization using 2-step UTI screening pathway reduced unnecessary invasive urine culture collection in hospitalized children. The novel spread of this initiative to inpatient pediatric units aligns with best practices promoting high-value care.

title: Advances in Plant Electrical Signals for Plant Health Monitoring and Smart Agriculture
abstractText: Plant electrical signals are fast electrophysiological responses to environmental stimuli, physiological regulation and stress. Because they often change before visible symptoms appear, they are attractive indicators for early plant-health monitoring and for sensing in precision agriculture. Research in this area has moved from recording single action potentials to analyzing the plant electrome, and now draws on flexible wearable electrodes, implantable and electrochemical sensors, machine learning, multi-source data fusion and edge-cloud computing. This review follows the technical chain from mechanism to application. We first summarize the physiological basis of the main signal types and how they relate to biotic and abiotic stress. We then compare acquisition technologies, including conventional electrodes, flexible wearable devices, microneedles and electrochemical sensors for biochemical markers. Next, we discuss preprocessing, multi-scale feature extraction, and recognition with conventional machine learning, deep learning and multi-source fusion. Finally, we examine applications in environmental sensing and stress identification and outline the remaining obstacles to field use. Most published results still come from laboratory or greenhouse studies with small datasets and non-standard protocols. Progress toward field deployment will depend on standardized acquisition and reporting, long-term sensor stability, cross-species and cross-site validation, open datasets, interpretable models and low-power edge inference. With these elements in place, plant electrical signals could serve as one component of decision-support systems for early warning and crop management.

abstractText: Abstrak Tahapan pengolahan karet alam konvensional secara umum masih panjang dan memerlukan waktu yang lama. Proses pengeringan menjadi tahapan utama dalam proses pengolahan karet alam. Teknologi pengeringan semprot dapat menjadi solusi untuk mengurangi proses pengolahan karet alam yang panjang. Penentuan dan perancangan ruang pengering serta kondisi operasi pengeringan semprot dapat dilakukan menggunakan simulasi komputasi. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengevaluasi dan mengkaji kondisi operasi dari proses pengeringan lateks karet alam menggunakan teknik pengeringan semprot melalui simulasi komputasi. Variabel perlakuan yang diberikan berupa laju alir umpan lateks (0,2; 0,4; 0,6; dan 0,8 kg/jam), kadar air umpan (70%, 75%, 80% dan 85%) dan suhu udara pengering (140 °C, 160 °C, 180 °C dan 200 °C). Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa variabel perlakuan yang diberikan memberikan pengaruh terhadap ukuran diameter droplet, laju pengeringan, serta bobot massa, kadar air, dan temperatur produk akhir. Berdasarkan hasil simulasi komputasi diperoleh bahwa kondisi operasi terbaik yang dapat dipilih untuk proses pengeringan semprot lateks karet alam yaitu laju alir umpan maksimum 0,4 kg/jam dengan temperatur udara pengering sekitar 180 °C. Kondisi operasi ini bisa diterapkan untuk ruang (chamber) pengering dengan dimensi bagian silinder berdiameter 35 cm dan ketinggian 63 cm serta ketinggian bagian kerucut sekitar 40 cm.

abstractText: Anemia affects approximately 32% of Indonesian adolescents, potentially impairing concentration, fitness, and growth. The government promotes iron supplementation tablets (TTD) in schools alongside visual/video-based health education. This community service activity aimed to improve students’ understanding of TTD consumption through video-based interactive lectures and a Participatory Action Research (PAR) approach. Conducted on July 30, 2026, at SD Negeri 105432 Kp. Ampera, the activity involved 32 sixth-grade students aged 11–12 years, comprising 15 boys and 17 girls, supported by homeroom teachers and the principal. Activities comprised preparation, planning, implementation and action, and evaluation and reflection. Knowledge was assessed using eight multiple-choice questions administered before and after the intervention. Understanding of anemia risks and symptoms increased by 55 percentage points, from 35% to 90%; knowledge of TTD benefits and consumption increased by 64 points, from 28% to 92%; and adherence and willingness to consume TTD increased by 48 points, from 40% to 88%. These findings indicate that visual-media education and participatory approaches effectively improve sixth-grade students’ understanding and awareness of healthy living.

Potential risks to public health based on molecular evidence of the mecA gene encoding Methicillin-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) isolated from cats swabbed in veterinary clinics and hospitals in Surabaya, Indonesia
abstractText: Abstract Background and aim Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) is a significant public health concern due to its resistance to β-lactam antibiotics. The presence of MRSA in companion animals, such as cats, raises concerns about zoonotic transmission, especially in veterinary settings where close human-animal interactions occur.This study aims to investigate the presence of the mecA gene in MRSA strains isolated from cats in veterinary clinics and hospitals in Surabaya, Indonesia, to assess potential risks to public health. Materials and methods A total of 215 cat swabs using Amies medium transport were collected from various Veterinary Clinics and Animal Hospitals in Surabaya. The samples were cultured on Mannitol Salt Agar (MSA) as selective media continued to Gram Staining, Catalase test, Coagulase test, and Voges-Proskauer (VP) test as identification of Staphylococcus aureus. The Staphylococcus aureus isolates continued to antibiotic resistance test using Kirby Bauer Method, the procedure involved streaking bacterial suspensions in accordance with the 0.5 McFarland standard, followed by the placement of eight different antibiotic disks on Mueller–Hinton Agar (MHA). Molecular detection of MRSA isolates identification was performed using conventional polymerase chain reaction (PCR). Results Out of the 215 samples, isolation and identification were identified 28 (13,02%) as Staphylococcus aureus. Antibiotic resistance test revealed there were 7 suspect Methicillin Resistance Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) and classified as multidrug resistance (MDR). The classification of these isolates as MRSA was phenotypically determined by their resistance to Cefoxitin, which serves as an indicator for phenotypic test for Methicillin Resistance Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA). Furthermore, the MDR status was established based on resistance to Trimethropim, Azithromycin, Gentamicin, Tetracycline, Oxacillin, Clindamycin, Amoxicillin. Molecular analysis via Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) confirmed the genotypic basis for this resistance, from the suspected MRSA isolates, there were 7 out of 27 S . aureus isolates (25%) were found to harbor the mecA gene. Conclusion The high prevalence of mecA -positive MRSA in cats from veterinary clinics and Animal Hospitals in Surabaya highlights a significant public health risk due to the potential for zoonotic transmission. This study underscores the necessity for enhanced surveillance and stringent infection control measures in veterinary practices to mitigate the spread of MRSA and protect both animal and human health. A One Health approach is essential to address the interconnectedness of human, animal, and environmental health in combating antibiotic resistance.

Influence of Digital Literacy, Learning Media, Student Engagement, and Self-Efficacy on English Reading Comprehension
abstractText: This study aims to examine the influence of digital literacy, learning media, student engagement, and self-efficacy on English reading comprehension in the context of digital learning. A quantitative research approach with an explanatory design was employed, involving a sample of 200 students selected through purposive sampling. Data were collected using a structured questionnaire measured on a five-point Likert scale and analyzed using multiple regression analysis. The results reveal that digital literacy, learning media, student engagement, and self-efficacy all have positive and significant effects on English reading comprehension. Among these variables, self-efficacy emerged as the strongest predictor, followed by digital literacy, student engagement, and learning media. The model demonstrates strong explanatory power, indicating that these variables collectively contribute substantially to students’ reading comprehension performance. The findings highlight the importance of integrating technological competencies, effective instructional media, active student participation, and psychological factors in enhancing reading outcomes. This study provides practical implications for educators to design more interactive, technology-integrated, and student-centered learning environments that foster both skills and confidence in reading English texts.

title: KETERLIBATAN AYAH DALAM PENGASUHAN SEBAGAI FAKTOR PROTEKTIF KESEHATAN MENTAL REMAJA
abstractText: ABSTRACT Adolescent mental health is associated with parenting experiences and the quality of family relationships, including father involvement. This study aimed to analyze the relationship between perceived father involvement in parenting and adolescent mental health in Tegal City and Regency. A quantitative correlational design was employed, involving 389 adolescents aged 13–17 years, comprising 140 males and 249 females. Data were collected using a 10-item Father Involvement Perception Scale and the 14-item Mental Health Continuum–Short Form (MHC-SF). Data were analyzed using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM). The results revealed a positive and significant relationship between perceived father involvement and adolescent mental health, with a path coefficient of 0.468, a t-statistic of 11.703, and a p-value of less than 0.001. The model explained 21.9% of the variance in adolescent mental health (R² = 0.219), with an effect size of 0.281 and a predictive relevance value of 0.203. Most respondents were classified as having moderate mental health (64.52%), followed by flourishing (31.36%) and languishing (4.11%). These findings indicate that perceived father involvement is associated with adolescent mental health, although a causal relationship cannot be established. ABSTRAK Kesehatan mental remaja berkaitan dengan pengalaman pengasuhan dan kualitas hubungan dalam keluarga, termasuk keterlibatan ayah. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis hubungan antara persepsi keterlibatan ayah dalam pengasuhan dan kesehatan mental remaja di Kota dan Kabupaten Tegal. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan desain korelasional yang melibatkan 389 remaja berusia 13–17 tahun, terdiri atas 140 laki-laki dan 249 perempuan. Data dikumpulkan melalui Skala Persepsi Keterlibatan Ayah yang terdiri atas 10 butir dan Mental Health Continuum–Short Form (MHC-SF) sebanyak 14 butir. Analisis data dilakukan menggunakan Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) melalui evaluasi model pengukuran dan model struktural. Hasil analisis menunjukkan hubungan positif dan signifikan antara persepsi keterlibatan ayah dan kesehatan mental remaja, dengan koefisien jalur sebesar 0,468, nilai t-statistics 11,703, dan p-value kurang dari 0,001. Model menjelaskan 21,9% variasi kesehatan mental remaja (R² = 0,219), dengan ukuran efek sebesar 0,281 dan nilai relevansi prediktif sebesar 0,203. Sebagian besar responden berada pada kategori kesehatan mental moderate (64,52%), diikuti flourishing (31,36%) dan languishing (4,11%). Temuan ini menegaskan keterkaitan persepsi keterlibatan ayah dengan kesehatan mental remaja, meskipun hubungan sebab-akibat belum dapat dipastikan.

abstractText: У статті розкрито особливості формування природничих уявлень і понять у дітей дошкільного віку з особливими освітніми потребами засобами альтернативної та додаткової комунікації. Актуальність дослідження зумовлена необхідністю забезпечення доступності освітнього процесу для дітей із порушеннями мовлення, розладами аутистичного спектра, інтелектуальними та комплексними порушеннями розвитку в умовах інклюзивної дошкільної освіти. Метою статті є теоретичне обґрунтування педагогічного потенціалу альтернативної та додаткової комунікації у процесі формування природничих уявлень і понять у дітей дошкільного віку в освітньому напрямі «Дитина в природному довкіллі». У дослідженні використано комплекс теоретичних методів: аналіз психолого-педагогічної, методичної та спеціальної літератури; узагальнення сучасних наукових підходів до організації інклюзивного освітнього середовища; систематизацію засобів альтернативної та додаткової комунікації та визначення їх педагогічних можливостей у природничо-пізнавальній діяльності дітей. Проаналізовано особливості використання низькотехнологічних і високотехнологічних засобів комунікації, зокрема жестів, піктограм, карток Picture Exchange Communication System, комунікативних таблиць, візуальних розкладів, електронних комунікаторів і мобільних застосунків. Результати дослідження свідчать, що використання альтернативної та додаткової комунікації забезпечує візуальну підтримку освітнього процесу, сприяє розвитку мовлення, сенсорного сприймання, пізнавальної активності та формуванню елементарних природничих узагальнень. Встановлено, що поєднання спостережень, практичної діяльності, елементарних дослідів і дидактичних ігор із засобами візуальної підтримки підвищує доступність навчального матеріалу та активізує участь дітей у пізнавальній діяльності. Визначено педагогічні умови ефективного використання альтернативної та додаткової комунікації: індивідуальний добір засобів комунікації, систематичність їх використання, поєднання мовленнєвої, візуальної та практичної підтримки, а також взаємодія педагогів і батьків. Зроблено висновок, що альтернативна та додаткова комунікація є ефективним засобом формування природничих уявлень і понять у дітей дошкільного віку з особливими освітніми потребами, оскільки забезпечує доступність освітнього процесу, підтримує комунікативну діяльність та створює умови для активного пізнання навколишнього світу.

abstractText: Pedagogical skills are a prerequisite for preservice teachers in facing modern learning; however, previous findings indicate that students still experience nervousness when teaching and hesitancy in operating technology, while studies linking psychological conditions to teaching competence remain limited and inconsistent. This study aimed to analyze the effects of mental well-being and academic stress on pedagogical skills, with computer self-efficacy as a mediating variable, grounded in the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB). This quantitative study used an explanatory design. The sample comprised 189 students of the Bachelor of Office Administration Education Study Program, class of 2023, Universitas Negeri Surabaya, who had undergone the school teaching practicum (Pengenalan Lapangan Persekolahan/PLP), selected through proportional random sampling. Data were collected using a five-point Likert-scale questionnaire and analyzed using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) with SmartPLS 3, including measurement model evaluation, model fit testing, coefficient of determination, and hypothesis testing through bootstrapping. The model showed good fit (SRMR = 0.075), with a coefficient of determination of 0.713 for pedagogical skills. Mental well-being had a positive and significant effect on computer self-efficacy (β = 0.380) and pedagogical skills (β = 0.250), while computer self-efficacy was the strongest predictor of pedagogical skills (β = 0.453) and partially mediated the effect of mental well-being (β = 0.172). Academic stress had a significant effect on computer self-efficacy (β = 0.340) and pedagogical skills (β = 0.258), including indirectly through partial mediation (β = 0.154); however, the positive direction contradicted the proposed hypotheses. These findings imply that preservice teachers' pedagogical skills are supported by mental well-being and computer self-efficacy in utilizing technology, whereas academic pressure during the PLP does not operate as a uniformly inhibiting factor. These results provide a basis for strengthening computer self-efficacy, mental well-being support, and academic stress management in PLP mentoring. ABSTRAK Pedagogical skills merupakan prasyarat bagi calon guru dalam menghadapi pembelajaran yang modern, tetapi temuan terdahulu menunjukkan bahwa mahasiswa masih mengalami kegugupan saat mengajar dan keraguan dalam mengoperasikan teknologi, sementara kajian yang mengaitkan kondisi psikologis dengan kompetensi mengajar masih terbatas dan belum konsisten. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis pengaruh mental well-being dan academic stress terhadap pedagogical skills dengan computer self-efficacy sebagai variabel mediasi, berlandaskan Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB). Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan rancangan eksplanatori. Sampel berjumlah 189 mahasiswa Program Studi S1 Pendidikan Administrasi Perkantoran angkatan 2023 Universitas Negeri Surabaya yang sudah menempuh Pengenalan Lapangan Persekolahan (PLP), ditetapkan melalui proportional random sampling. Data dikumpulkan dengan angket berskala Likert lima poin dan dianalisis menggunakan Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) berbantuan SmartPLS 3, yang mencakup evaluasi model pengukuran, uji kecocokan model, koefisien determinasi, dan pengujian hipotesis melalui bootstrapping. Model menunjukkan kecocokan yang baik (SRMR = 0,075) dengan koefisien determinasi pedagogical skills sebesar 0,713. Hasil analisis menunjukkan bahwa mental well-being berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap computer self-efficacy (β = 0,380) dan pedagogical skills (β = 0,250), sedangkan computer self-efficacy merupakan prediktor terkuat pedagogical skills (β = 0,453) dan memediasi secara parsial pengaruh mental well-being (β = 0,172). Academic stress berpengaruh signifikan terhadap computer self-efficacy (β = 0,340) dan pedagogical skills (β = 0,258), termasuk secara tidak langsung dengan mediasi parsial (β = 0,154); namun, arah pengaruh yang positif tidak sejalan dengan hipotesis yang diajukan. Temuan ini mengimplikasikan bahwa pedagogical skills calon guru didukung oleh mental well-being dan computer self-efficacy dalam memanfaatkan teknologi, sedangkan tekanan akademik selama PLP tidak bekerja sebagai faktor penghambat yang seragam. Hasil ini menjadi dasar bagi penguatan computer self-efficacy, dukungan mental well-being, dan pengelolaan academic stress dalam pendampingan PLP.

title: A Telomere-to-Telomere Genome Assembly and Demographic History Inference of Ostrya rehderiana
abstractText: Abstract Ostrya rehderiana is a critically endangered plant species with an extremely small population size. However, the absence of high-quality genome assembly has impeded the understanding of the causes and genetic consequences of its endangered status, especially how theses genetic consequences result in the failure of its population regeneration. In this study, we integrated PacBio HiFi, Oxford Nanopore (ONT) long-read sequencing, Hi-C, Illumina resequencing, and RNA-seq data to generate a telomere-to-telomere (T2T) genome assembly and annotation for this species. The assembled genome has a total size of 349.04 Mb and was successfully anchored to eight pseudochromosomes. A total of 28,698 protein-coding genes were predicted, of which 27,476 were functionally annotated. The BUSCO completeness score reached 98.9%, indicating a high level of assembly completeness and accuracy. Based on this T2T genome assembly, we reconstructed historical changes in effective population size using the PSMC model. The results revealed pronounced long-term fluctuations in population size, followed by a recent continuous decline. This study provides an important genomic resource for exploring the mechanisms underlying the endangered status of O. rehderiana offering a foundation for conservation genetics research on plant species with extremely small populations.

abstractText: Knowledge of minor wound care is essential for students to prevent infections and complications caused by inappropriate wound management. This study aimed to determine the effectiveness of a video-based demonstration method in improving knowledge of minor wound care among tenth-grade students at SMA Negeri 15 Adidarma Banda Aceh. This study employed a pre-experimental design with a one-group pretest-posttest approach. The sample consisted of 30 respondents selected using total sampling. Data were collected using questionnaires administered before and after the intervention and analyzed using the Wilcoxon Signed Ranks Test. The results showed that the mean knowledge score increased from 10,60 at pretest to 14,17 at posttest. Statistical analysis yielded a Z value of -4.708 with a p-value of less than 0.001. These findings indicate a significant difference in knowledge before and after the intervention. Therefore, the video-based demonstration method was effective in improving students' knowledge of minor wound care.

title: P2RY11–SIRT1–PGC-1α–dependent mitochondrial redox and bioenergetic regulation of macrophages drives fin regeneration in zebrafish
abstractText: Abstract Background Tissue regeneration is an energy-intensive process that requires coordinated mitochondrial bioenergetics and redox homeostasis. Extracellular ATP is rapidly released after tissue injury, but how ATP-derived signals support regenerative repair remains incompletely understood. Here, we investigated whether the purinergic receptor P2RY11 regulates macrophage mitochondrial metabolism and thereby promotes tissue regeneration. Methods Using zebrafish caudal fin regeneration as an in vivo model, we examined regenerative outgrowth, cell proliferation, macrophage accumulation and migration, mitochondrial function, redox status, and metabolic gene expression in p2ry11 -deficient larvae. Genetic ablation and pharmacological inhibition of P2RY11 were combined with macrophage depletion and pathway rescue experiments targeting the SIRT1–PGC-1α axis and PPARγ signaling. Results Loss or inhibition of p2ry11 markedly impaired caudal fin regeneration, reduced injury-induced cell proliferation, and decreased macrophage migratory capacity and accumulation at the wound site. Mechanistically, p2ry11 deficiency disrupted systemic mitochondrial metabolic and redox homeostasis, as evidenced by a reduced NAD⁺/NADH ratio and decreased PGC-1α expression. Importantly, cell-resolved analyses further revealed mitochondrial depolarization, increased mtROS accumulation, and reduced ATP levels specifically in injury-associated macrophages. Systemic antioxidant defense was also compromised, with reduced CAT and SOD activities, decreased GSH content, and suppressed expression of antioxidant-related genes. Pharmacological activation of SIRT1 or PGC-1α restored mitochondrial redox and bioenergetic function and rescued fin regeneration, whereas inhibition of PGC-1α abolished the SIRT1-mediated rescue. Importantly, macrophage depletion eliminated the regenerative benefits of SIRT1–PGC-1α activation, demonstrating that macrophages are essential effectors of this pathway. Treatment with the clinically approved PPARγ agonist rosiglitazone similarly restored macrophage mitochondrial function and rescued regeneration, whereas activation of canonical cAMP–PKA or PKC signaling failed to improve regenerative outcomes. Conclusions These findings identify P2RY11 as an injury-responsive metabolic regulator that promotes tissue regeneration by sustaining macrophage mitochondrial bioenergetics and redox balance through the NAD + –SIRT1–PGC-1α axis. Targeting macrophage mitochondrial fitness may provide a therapeutic strategy for enhancing regenerative repair.

title: Comparing Random Forest and SHAP Feature Selection for LSTM-Based Stock Price Prediction
abstractText: Feature selection is often used in stock price prediction, but its results remain mixed. This study analyzes the effect of feature selection based on Random Forest native feature importance (RF Importance) and SHAP on LSTM performance in predicting ADRO, ASII, and TLKM stock prices. Daily data from May 2021 to May 2026 were processed into 20 relative features from price, volume, technical indicators, and the Jakarta Composite Index (JCI), with return as the target. Both methods used the same Random Forest model and a mean-score threshold, while the LSTM was evaluated with five seeds and compared with a naive model. Feature selection reduced the input from 20 to 9 - 12 features (40% to 55%) and the LSTM parameters from 125,761 to 120,129 - 121,665 (3.3% to 4.5%). The MAPE of all schemes ranged from 1.76% to 1.90%, close to the naive model (1.72% to 1.87%), with differences between schemes of no more than 0.07 percentage points. Only for ADRO did the all-features scheme perform clearly better. Both methods retained the volume and JCI features and removed redundant trend indicators, with SHAP selecting fewer features. Therefore, the main benefit of feature selection was a simpler model input, not better prediction accuracy.

title: Pengembangan Bahan Ajar Menulis Teks Eksplanasi Berbantuan Diorama Digital untuk Siswa Kelas VII SMP Swasta Harapan 1 Medan
abstractText: Learning to write explanatory texts in grade VII students still faces obstacles, such as limited learning media that only uses textbooks, low understanding of text structure, and lack of student interest. This study aims to develop explanatory text writing teaching materials assisted by digital diorama for grade VII students of SMP Swasta Harapan 1 Medan and to analyze their feasibility and effectiveness. This study employs the Research and Development method with the ADDIE model consisting of five stages: analysis, design, development, implementation, and evaluation. The research subjects were 30 grade VII students. The instruments used included a needs questionnaire, expert validation sheets for material and design, teacher and student response questionnaires, and pre-test and post-test questions. The results show that the developed teaching materials obtained content feasibility of 93%, presentation feasibility of 94%, and language feasibility of 96.6% with a very feasible criterion, while the design expert gave a score of 80% with a feasible criterion. The Indonesian language teacher's response obtained an average score of 94% with a very feasible criterion. The effectiveness of the teaching materials is proven by the increase in students' average score from 66 in the pre-test to 87 in the post-test, which has exceeded the minimum completeness criterion (KKM) of 75. Thus, the explanatory text writing teaching materials assisted by digital diorama are declared feasible and effective for use in learning.

title: Triangulación y significado; el rol de "Ello" en la teoría del significado de Quine
abstractText: Este artículo es parte de una investigación más amplia que tiene por objetivo determinar el papel que juega el elemento no lingüístico en la conformación del significado lingüistico. En este caso nos proponemos analizar el rol que dicho elemento juega en la semantica de W.V. Quine. Como señala, Davidson el rol de dicho elemento en la obra de Quine es ambiguo; juega un rol determinado en la descripción del aprendizaje del lenguaje y otro diferente en la determinación del singificado de las expresiones. El objetivo de este artículo es dar argumentos a favor de la tesis de que pese al papel que Quine atribuye al objeto como constructo, no puede prescindir de apelar a una instancia no lingüística que juega un rol determinante en la construcción del significado. La tesis que pretendemos sostener es que aún cuando Quine pretende prescindir de dicho elemento por medio de la apelación a patrones de estimulación como la fuente derterminante del significado, su pretensión es infurctuosa y no tiene modo de eludir una instancia objetiva compartida como determinante del mismo.

abstractText: У статті розкрито сучасне розуміння методу «Сенсорна дієта» та особливості партнерської співпраці між фахівцями і батьками дітей з особливими освітніми потребами (ООП) у процесі його планування й реалізації. Метою статті є представлення авторського бачення планування та реалізації сенсорної дієти, що ґрунтується на інтерпретації моделі Person–Environment–Occupation (PEO), а також обґрунтування партнерського підходу до співпраці між фахівцями та батьками як необхідної умови інтеграції сенсорної дієти у повсякденне життя дитини. На основі аналізу українських і зарубіжних джерел визначено особливості сучасного розуміння партнерської взаємодії між фахівцями та батьками, а також показано еволюцію методу «Сенсорна дієта»: від застосування окремих сенсорних технік до системи сенсорної підтримки, інтегрованої у повсякденне життя дитини з ООП. Показано, що зміна наукових уявлень про сенсорну дієту супроводжувалася переходом від переважно терапевтичної моделі до розуміння її як засобу підтримки участі дитини у життєдіяльності. Представлено авторську інтерпретацію моделі PEO, адаптовану до планування та реалізації сенсорної дієти, у якій центральне місце відведено участі дитини у житті як провідній умові розширення її можливостей, розвитку та навчання. Систематизовано відмінності між традиційним та партнерським підходами до співпраці фахівців і батьків; обґрунтовано необхідність безперервної взаємодії між ними протягом усього процесу реалізації програми втручання. Наголошено, що важливою складовою партнерської взаємодії є систематичне консультування батьків, спрямоване на інтеграцію сенсорних стратегій у природні ситуації. Доведено, що за такого підходу партнерство між фахівцями та батьками набуває характеру спільного проєктування життєдіяльності дитини, у якому об’єднання професійних знань фахівців і життєвого досвіду родини створює умови для підтримки її розвитку, навчання та активної участі у житті. Запропонований підхід розширює сучасне розуміння сенсорної дієти, розглядаючи її не як окремий терапевтичний метод, а як засіб організації повсякденного життя дитини за умови партнерської взаємодії фахівців і батьків.

title: ROLE OF ACCELERATORS AND INCUBATORS IN INSPIRATION LABS- A DETAILED FRAMEWORK FOR SOCIO-ECONOMIC TRANSFORMATION
abstractText: This paper examines the role of incubators and accelerators within the Inspiration Economy framework, arguing that these mechanisms are not merely institutional tools but constitute a coherent methodology for converting socio-economic problems into sustainable opportunities. Drawing extensively on the theoretical and empirical corpus developed by inspiration economy theory lab, the paper situates incubators and accelerators within the broader architecture of Inspiration Labs—field-based environments where observation, associative thinking, and iterative experimentation converge. The paper expands the theoretical foundation by engaging particularly with Mednick's associative theory of creativity, Koestler's concept of bisociation, and Edgar Morin's complexity theory, to demonstrate how the incubator-accelerator continuum operationalizes a distinctive epistemology of problem-solving. Through analysis of case studies from Mauritania, Bahrain, Bosnia, and Ghana, the paper shows that incubators build the "roots" of capacity and self-reliance, while accelerators drive the "growth" of proven models toward scale and systemic impact. The paper concludes that the integration of these two mechanisms within Inspiration Labs represents a viable pathway toward what a civilizational renaissance grounded in local assets, associative capacity, and the transformation of challenges into inspirational currencies.

title: Pengaruh Struktur Modal, Profitabilitas, dan Likuiditas terhadap Risiko Keuangan pada Perusahaan Makanan dan Minuman di BEI
abstractText: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis pengaruh struktur modal, profitabilitas, dan likuiditas terhadap risiko keuangan pada perusahaan subsektor makanan dan minuman yang terdaftar di Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI). Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan data panel periode 2020–2024. Sampel terdiri dari 56 perusahaan yang dipilih menggunakan teknik purposive sampling, dengan total 280 observasi. Risiko keuangan diukur menggunakan Interest Coverage Ratio (ICR), sedangkan analisis data dilakukan melalui regresi data panel dengan Fixed Effects Model dan cluster-robust standard errors untuk mengatasi heteroskedastisitas. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa profitabilitas berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap ICR, yang mengindikasikan bahwa peningkatan profitabilitas berkaitan dengan meningkatnya kemampuan perusahaan dalam memenuhi kewajiban pembayaran bunga. Sementara itu, struktur modal dan likuiditas tidak berpengaruh signifikan terhadap ICR. Temuan ini menunjukkan bahwa profitabilitas berperan penting dalam mendukung kemampuan perusahaan memenuhi kewajiban bunga, sedangkan struktur modal dan likuiditas belum menunjukkan pengaruh yang signifikan secara statistik selama periode penelitian.

title: 舞台小说的数字演艺空间转化与沉浸式互动设计
abstractText: 《喜剧》是以喜剧笔法写就之喜剧演员(丑角)悲喜交织、跌宕起伏、动人心魄的生命故事。作者以贺氏一门父子两代人的生活和命运为主线，在戏与人生的交相互动中牵连出广阔的人间世各色人等的生命情状——怨憎会、爱别离、求不得诸般际遇所致之起落、成败、得失、荣辱等等不一而足，并于此间表达了对戏曲与历史、时代和现实关系的透彻理解。同作者的作品《主角》《妆台》《西京故事》已被改编为现代戏。以小说《喜剧》作为选题，可谓踩在了创新的前沿，又能站在巨人的肩膀上，吸收现代戏改编的经验。数字演艺空间和沉浸式演出是融合了新媒体计算机技术和传统舞台美术空间设计的新型艺术形式。凭借高度发达的计算机图形技术，通过三维建模、物理计算、虚拟灯光、数字音效等手段达到传统舞台受限于现实因素无法达到的效果。并且其媒介特性极大地扩宽了虚拟舞台空间的传播渠道，通过互联网，人们可以使用移动设备随时随地地欣赏虚拟舞台空间。同时，其设计由于数字化的特性，可以方便地转换成电影、电视、艺术展览和其他跨媒体艺术形式，有助于提升了观众的沉浸感、交互性和观赏性；有助于在数智时代形成对当代受众群体的实质性吸纳，促进中华优秀传统文化的创造性转化和创新性发展。

title: Dampak Ekonomi Ruas Jalan Trans Wamena terhadap Pemilihan Moda Transportasi di Distrik Kobakma, Kabupaten Mamberamo Tengah, Provinsi Papua Pegunungan
abstractText: Pembangunan Jalan Trans Wamena membuka akses transportasi darat di Papua Pegunungan, tetapi distribusi logistik ke Distrik Kobakma masih bergantung pada moda dengan karakteristik waktu, biaya, dan pelayanan yang berbeda. Penelitian ini bertujuan menentukan moda transportasi logistik paling efektif pada rute Jayapura–Wamena dan Wamena–Kobakma dengan membandingkan angkutan darat (truk), udara kargo (Trigana), dan udara perintis (Susi Air) menggunakan metode Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP). Pendekatan kuantitatif dan kualitatif digunakan melalui observasi, wawancara, dan kuesioner kepada pemangku kepentingan logistik. Kriteria analisis meliputi waktu, biaya, dan kemudahan pelayanan, yang kemudian dikaitkan dengan harga jual sembako di Distrik Kobakma. Hasil penelitian diharapkan memberikan bobot prioritas moda transportasi paling efisien serta gambaran pengaruhnya terhadap harga komoditas sembako. Temuan ini menjadi masukan strategis bagi pemerintah dan pelaku logistik untuk meningkatkan keterjangkauan harga kebutuhan pokok di wilayah pegunungan Papua, khususnya di Distrik Kobakma.

Children and Families Affected by Parental Substance Use: Clinical Report
abstractText: Children and adolescents whose parents have an alcohol or substance use disorder are at increased risk of short- and long-term sequelae, ranging from medical conditions to psychosocial, safety, and behavioral challenges. In the course of providing health care services to children, pediatricians and other pediatric clinicians are likely to encounter families affected by parental substance use and are in a unique position to support the well-being of both the child and family. The purpose of this clinical report is to briefly discuss the epidemiology of substance use during pregnancy and while parenting in the United States; highlight the influence of bias, racism, and other structural inequities on families affected by substance use; describe the known risks associated with prenatal and postnatal parental substance use; discuss use and interpretation of toxicology testing as part of a substance exposure evaluation; review approaches to screening for prenatal and parental substance use; propose key topics for anticipatory guidance in the pediatric clinic; identify and address concerning parental and child presentations related to parental substance use leading to concern for child abuse or neglect; and provide recommendations for pediatric clinicians involved in the care of children from families affected by substance use.

Exploring English Language Learning Challenges and English Needs for Academic and Professional Purposes in an EFL Context: Evidence from Applied College Students at King Faisal University
abstractText: This study investigates the English language learning challenges and needs of Applied College students at King Faisal University within an English as a Foreign Language (EFL) context. Although English language learning challenges have been widely examined in Saudi higher education, comparatively less attention has been given to the challenges and language needs of students in applied and vocationally oriented programs. Using a mixed-methods needs-analysis design, the study integrates quantitative data from a structured questionnaire (n = 278) with qualitative insights from semi-structured interviews. Quantitative data were analyzed using descriptive statistics and Pearson correlation analysis, while qualitative data were analyzed thematically. Findings indicate that language learning is shaped by the interaction of linguistic, affective, pedagogical, and environmental factors. Vocabulary limitations and speaking difficulties were prominent, with a strong positive correlation between linguistic and affective factors (r = .771, p < .01). Limited communicative practice and active English use further constrained language development. Students reported strong English language needs, particularly in career-related skills (M = 4.02) and technical vocabulary (M = 3.99). By integrating multiple dimensions of language-learning challenges with students’ perceived needs, the study provides a learner-centered account of English learning in applied higher education. The findings offer implications for more communicative and professionally relevant English provision in comparable vocational higher-education EFL contexts.

Selenium and nano-selenium in horticultural produce: from preharvest biofortification to postharvest preservation
abstractText: Abstract Postharvest losses of fruits and vegetables caused by microbial spoilage and physiological disorders remain a significant challenge to global food security. Selenium (Se), particularly ionic Se and selenium nanoparticles (SeNPs), has demonstrated significant potential for the preservation of postharvest fruits and vegetables. This review summarizes the roles of ionic Se and SeNPs in maintaining the postharvest quality of horticultural produce. Furthermore, it highlights recent advances in SeNPs synthesis and the fabrication of SeNPs-based edible coatings using natural polymers for postharvest preservation applications. Both ionic Se and SeNPs improve postharvest quality by inhibiting microbial decay, delaying fruit ripening, and maintaining the nutritional properties of stored fruits and vegetables. Compared with ionic forms, SeNPs offer greater stability, controllable Se release, and low toxicity, making them ideal candidates for edible coating fabrication. Integrating SeNPs into natural biopolymers, such as chitosan (CT), alginate, and starch, improves coating strength, gas barrier properties, and overall preservation performance. These coatings effectively suppress microbial growth, reduce oxidative damage, delay senescence, and extend shelf life while maintaining sensory quality. Notably, postharvest Se application is a valuable source of Se micronutrient biofortification, further enhancing the nutritional value of stored fruits and vegetables. In addition, green-synthesized SeNPs are safer and more sustainable compared with chemically synthesized SeNPs, minimizing potential environmental risk. Despite their potential as multifunctional nanotechnology for postharvest management, further studies on toxicity, safety regulations, and large-scale production are required to ensure their practical and commercial applicability.
