The potential for large-scale genome editing in finfish aquaculture via germline stem cell culture and transplantation
abstractText: Genome editing has emerged as a promising tool to complement selective breeding programmes and accelerate genetic gain in aquaculture. Although CRISPR-based genome editing has been successfully applied in several economically important fish species, its application at an industry-relevant scale remains challenging due to limitations of current delivery methods, which primarily rely on manual embryo microinjection. This approach is labour-intensive, technically demanding, and frequently results in high levels of mosaicism in founder individuals, necessitating additional generations of breeding to establish stable genotypes. In this mini review, we discuss the potential of combining germline stem cell (GSC) culture and transplantation approaches as an alternative platform for further improved genome editing in fish. By enabling genetic changes to be introduced, validated, and expanded in vitro prior to germline transmission, this approach has the potential to improve scalability, reduce mosaicism, and shorten breeding timelines. Although several technical challenges remain, continued progress in GSC culture and transplantation methodologies could facilitate the practical implementation of tailored genome editing for improved genetic gain, fish health, and welfare in aquaculture.

title: Influence of Growth Mindset, Time Management, and Academic Self-Efficacy on Academic Achievement
abstractText: This study examines the influence of growth mindset, time management, and academic self-efficacy on students’ academic achievement. Grounded in the theoretical perspectives of Carol Dweck’s mindset theory and Albert Bandura’s social cognitive theory, the research aims to explore how cognitive beliefs, behavioral strategies, and motivational factors contribute to academic performance. A quantitative research design was employed, utilizing a structured survey questionnaire administered to a sample of students. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, correlation analysis, and multiple regression techniques. The findings reveal that all three independent variables significantly and positively predict academic achievement, with academic self-efficacy emerging as the strongest predictor, followed by time management and growth mindset. The model explains a substantial proportion of variance in academic performance, highlighting the combined importance of psychological and behavioral factors in educational success. The study contributes to the existing literature by integrating multiple theoretical frameworks into a single model and providing empirical evidence of their combined effects. The findings suggest that educational interventions aimed at enhancing students’ self-efficacy, fostering a growth mindset, and improving time management skills can significantly improve academic outcomes. These results have important implications for educators, policymakers, and students seeking to enhance academic performance through holistic development strategies.

Analisis Litofasies dan Mikropaleontologi Dalam Penentuan Lingkungan Pengendapan Formasi Halang Daerah Bodeh dan Sekitarnya, Kabupaten Pemalang, Jawa Tengah
abstractText: Formasi Halang di daerah Bodeh, Kabupaten Pemalang, Jawa Tengah, merupakan suksesi sedimen klastik laut dalam yang merekam proses sedimentasi turbidit dalam Cekungan Serayu Utara. Pemahaman terhadap lingkungan pengendapannya menjadi penting untuk merekonstruksi evolusi cekungan dan sejarah tektono-sedimentasi regional pada kala Neogen. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menentukan lingkungan pengendapan Formasi Halang melalui analisis terpadu sedimentologi, stratigrafi, dan mikropaleontologi. Metode penelitian meliputi pengukuran penampang stratigrafi terukur, karakterisasi litofasies, analisis struktur sedimen, kajian petrografi, serta identifikasi foraminifera planktonik dan bentonik untuk penentuan umur dan interpretasi batimetri. Asosiasi fasies tersusun atas perselingan batupasir, batupasir andesitik, dan batulempung yang menunjukkan sekuen Bouma tidak lengkap (Tb–Tc–Te), struktur graded bedding, wavy lamination, serta pola coarsening upward yang khas endapan arus turbidit. Data mikropaleontologi menunjukkan umur Miosen Akhir–Pliosen Tengah dan mengindikasikan lingkungan pengendapan pada zona outer neritic hingga upper bathyal. Hasil penelitian ini menunjukkan bahwa Formasi Halang di daerah penelitian diendapkan dalam sistem kipas bawah laut (submarine fan) bagian lower fan hingga middle fan pada cekungan busur muka aktif yang dipengaruhi proses tektonik dan vulkanik Neogen.

Attitudes and perceptions toward the use of artificial intelligence chatbots for peer review in medical journals: a large-scale, international cross-sectional survey
abstractText: Abstract Background Artificial intelligence chatbots (AICs) are increasingly being considered for use in scholarly peer review to assist with tasks such as identifying methodological issues, verifying references, and improving language clarity. However, concerns remain regarding their reliability, ethical implications, and transparency. Evidence on how medical journal peer reviewers perceive the role and impact of AICs is limited. This study explored reviewers’ familiarity with AICs, perceived benefits and challenges, ethical concerns, and anticipated future roles in peer review. Methods We conducted a cross-sectional online survey of medical journal peer reviewers. Corresponding author information was extracted from MEDLINE-indexed articles added to PubMed within a six-week period. A total of 72,851 authors were invited via email to participate; those who self-identified as peer reviewers were eligible. The 29-item survey assessed familiarity with AICs and perceptions of their benefits and limitations in peer review. The survey was administered via SurveyMonkey from April 28 to June 16, 2025, with two reminder emails sent during the data collection period. Results Of 66,679 email invitations, a total of 1260 respondents provided survey responses (response rate: 1.9%), of whom 1157 met the eligibility criteria, and 1077 answered the main survey questions. Most participants were familiar with AICs (86.2%) and had used them for general purposes (87.7%), though most report not using AICs for peer review purposes (70.3%). Most respondents reported that their institutions do not provide training on AIC use in peer review (69.5%), although many expressed interest in such training (60.7%). Perceptions of AIC benefits were mixed, while concerns were widely shared, particularly regarding potential algorithmic bias (80.3%) and issues related to trust and user acceptance (73.3%). Conclusions While familiarity with AICs is high among medical journal peer reviewers, their reported use in peer review remains limited. There is clear interest in training and guidance, however, concerns related to ethics, data privacy, and research integrity persist and should be addressed before broader implementation.

Implementation of Deep Learning Approach in Indonesian Language Learning at SMA/SMK/MAN Cirebon City
abstractText: Background. Indonesian language instruction at the high school (SMA), vocational high school (SMK), and Islamic high school (MAN) levels still tends to be focused on mastering course content, resulting in students' in-depth understanding not yet being optimal. Aims. This study aims to describe the implementation of the deep learning approach in Indonesian language instruction at high schools, vocational high schools, and Islamic high schools in Cirebon City, examining aspects of planning, implementation, language use, instructional structure, as well as challenges and their solutions. Methods. The study employed a qualitative approach using descriptive methods; data were collected through observation, interviews, and documentation, then analyzed using the Miles and Huberman interactive model. Result. The results indicate that all three schools have applied the principles of meaningful learning, mindful learning, and joyful learning to varying degrees, with one school demonstrating the most optimal implementation due to consistency across all aspects of instruction. Challenges still faced include time constraints, variations in student abilities, and less-than-ideal classroom conditions, which teachers address through adaptive strategies such as the use of engaging learning media and adjustments to teaching methods. Conclusion. This study concludes that the successful implementation of deep learning depends not only on the planning and execution of instruction but also on strengthening teacher competencies and support from the learning environment.

title: Quantified Chronic High-Radon Exposure is Associated with Compartment-Specific Alteration of Peripheral Blood hsa_circ_0040573: A Cross-Sectional Study
abstractText: Chronic exposure to geogenic radon, an important naturally occurring element, is a public health concern, yet our knowledge regarding alterations of human circular RNA (circRNA) remains limited. We conducted a cross-sectional study of 94 residents (exposed group, n = 46, with regular bathing in a high-radon hot spring environment; control group, n = 48, without hot-spring-related high-radon exposure) to evaluate associations between quantified chronic radon exposure and peripheral blood hsa_circ_0040573 expression. We measured radon concentrations in the bathing microenvironments using solid-state nuclear track detectors (CR-39) and estimated individual cumulative effective doses from measured concentrations and bathing patterns. Hsa_circ_0040573 expression was quantified in plasma and the peripheral blood cellular fraction. We used multivariable linear regression to assess exposure-response associations. Bioinformatics analysis and targeted quantitative reverse transcription PCR (qRT-PCR) were used to explore a putative hsa_circ_0040573-centered ceRNA axis. The mean radon concentration in the primary bathing areas was 2.28 × 10 4 Bq/m 3 , corresponding to an estimated individual cumulative dose of 70.22 mSv (IQR: 29.17–109.71 mSv) among exposed participants. Compared with controls, hsa_circ_0040573 expression was higher in plasma but lower in the peripheral blood cellular fraction in the exposed group. After multivariable adjustment, cumulative radon dose was inversely associated with hsa_circ_0040573 expression in the peripheral blood cellular fraction (standardized β = –0.304, 95% CI: –0.537 to –0.072). Bioinformatics analysis prioritized hsa-miR-338-3p within a hsa_circ_0040573-centered competing endogenous RNA (ceRNA network), with enrichment in vascular endothelial growth factor receptor signaling. Targeted validation in the peripheral blood cellular fraction showed decreased ATP1A2 and increased hsa-miR-338-3p among exposed participants. These findings indicate that quantified chronic high-radon exposure is associated with compartment-specific alteration of peripheral blood circRNA signals and provide human molecular evidence for a radon-related response, with preliminary support for a candidate hsa_circ_0040573/hsa-miR-338-3p/ATP1A2 regulatory axis.

title: Adherence to Preoperative Ceftriaxone and Metronidazole Improves Outcomes in Acute Appendicitis
abstractText: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE Acute appendicitis is the most common pediatric surgical emergency, with approximately 70 000 cases annually in the United States. Preoperative antibiotic regimens vary widely. Prior to 2024, our institution used cefoxitin or meropenem based on perceived perforation status. To align with evidence supporting narrow-spectrum regimens, we implemented a standardized antibiotic protocol, aiming to increase use of recommended first-line preoperative antibiotics—intravenous ceftriaxone and metronidazole (CRO-MTZ)—for pediatric emergency department (PED) patients undergoing appendectomy for acute appendicitis from 0% to 75% within 8 months. METHODS Our “Appendicitis Antibiotic Bundle” interventions included targeted education, pathway revision, and electronic health record updates. The primary measure was administration of CRO-MTZ. Secondary measures included preoperative antipseudomonal antibiotic use and antibiotic cost. Balancing measures were PED and hospital length of stay (LOS) and surgical site infections (SSIs). Statistical process control methods were used for analysis. We evaluated measures for both PED and all appendicitis patients, including those transferred from other facilities. RESULTS Administration of CRO-MTZ increased from 0% to 86% for PED and to 77% for all appendicitis patients. Preoperative antipseudomonal antibiotic use decreased from 19.1% to 5.5% in PED patients. The hospital-wide appendicitis SSI rate declined from 4.0% to 1.4%. There was a 21% decrease in preoperative antibiotic costs, a 25-minute reduction in PED LOS, and a 9.9-hour reduction in hospital LOS. All measures achieved special cause variation. CONCLUSIONS Associated with standardizing preoperative antibiotics for acute appendicitis, we noted reduced broad-spectrum antibiotic use and cost without increasing SSIs or LOS.

title: Learnable Unified Structure under Global-Local Consistency for Unsupervised Feature Selection
abstractText: Abstract Previous unsupervised feature selection methods typically model global data distributions and local geometric structures separately or via parallel constraints. Such decoupled modeling often leads to structural inconsistencies due to the lack of a unified representation of sample relationships. Moreover, existing local structure-based methods generally rely on predefined and fixed adjacency graphs, which often contain noise and redundancy, further degrading the learning performance. To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel Unified Structural Matrix Framework (USMF) for unsupervised feature selection. Specifically, a dynamically learnable, non-negative, symmetric structure matrix is introduced to consistently capture both global and local structural relationships within a single variable. This matrix preserves the global data structure via a trace-maximizing term, similar to weighted principal component analysis, while maintaining local geometric relationships via weighted distance constraints in the embedding space. Furthermore, a Frobenius norm (F-norm) consistency constraint is introduced to preserve neighborhood information and stabilize structure learning. Concurrently, an l2;1-norm regularization is imposed on the projection matrix to achieve effective feature selection. An alternating optimization algorithm is designed to solve the proposed model. Extensive experiments on multiple public datasets demonstrate that USMF outperforms existing state-of-the-art unsupervised feature selection methods in terms of Clustering Accuracy (ACC) and Normalized Mutual Information (NMI).

title: Delineation of hazardous regions in the unit hypercube: A copula-based approximation for the identification of low-frequency compound occurrences
abstractText: Abstract The probabilistic characterization of compound extreme events, defined as those arising from the joint action of several (generally dependent) drivers, is a central problem in engineering hydrology and water resources. The copula-based scenarios customarily used in the literature (i.e., OR, AND, Kendall, and survival Kendall) summarize multivariate risk by tracing a single boundary in the unit hypercube and assigning to it a target probability, or equivalently a return period. Except for the rectangular OR and AND cases, the prescribed probability attaches to the bounding layer rather than to the hazardous region itself, which is then determined only implicitly. Moreover, the marginal exceedance rates of the drivers are fixed by the level of the critical layer and cannot be set independently. Here we introduce a copula-based approximation that characterizes the hazardous region directly as a full-dimensional set to which the target exceedance frequency is attached. The boundary of this set consists of linear segments meeting at a vertex at the point of maximum curvature of an equiprobability surface of the copula. Crucially, the per-variable exceedance rates are predefined by the user, so that application-specific marginal rates are reconciled with the joint target within a single region, allowing asymmetric compound occurrences (e.g., high discharge under moderate coastal water level, or the reverse) to be accommodated naturally. We develop the formulation in the frequency domain for both exchangeable and non-exchangeable copulas, provide a direct extension to higher dimensions, and demonstrate it on the symmetric and asymmetric versions of the Clayton and Gumbel copulas, taken as representative models of lower- and upper-tail dependence. The resulting construction is simple to implement and particularly suited to early-warning systems, in which a hazardous combination of drivers must be recognized as it develops.

The impact of push and pull motivation on visitor experience in wine festivals
abstractText: Purpose Wine festivals are events in which wine is the primary attraction, but they often include a range of complementary offerings that enhance the overall visitor experience. Understanding visitors' motivations and experiences is essential for effective festival management. This study aims to examine the motivations and experiences of visitors at a traditional wine festival in Serbia and explore the relationship between visitor motivation and visitor experience. Design/methodology/approach The target population consisted of adult festival visitors, including both local residents and tourists, at the Oplenačka berba festival. Data were collected through an online survey, yielding a final sample of 162 respondents. Descriptive statistics were used to profile the sample. Principal component analysis identified the latent constructs of motivation and experience, while multiple regression analysis examined the predictive relationship between motivation and different aspects of experience. Findings The results revealed two distinct motivational factors: push and pull. Visitor experience was captured through three main factors: Sensory-Emotional-Cognitive Experience, Service and Social Interaction, and Novelty and Uniqueness. Both push and pull motivation significantly influenced all dimensions of experience, with push motivations demonstrating a stronger overall effect. Originality/value This study contributes to the literature on event-based wine tourism by demonstrating the central role of internal motivations in shaping holistic festival experiences. The findings offer practical insights for festival organisers aiming to enhance visitor satisfaction and highlight the importance of socially immersive elements in traditional wine festivals.

Analisa Kinerja Jaringan Irigasi dengan Pendekatan IKSI di Daerah Irigasi Rolak Songo ( Studi Kasus : Saluran Sekunder Kedung Ploso dan Saluran Sekunder Mindu Gading)
abstractText: The availability and condition of irrigation networks are important factors in supporting the smooth distribution of water to agricultural land and the sustainability of agricultural activities. Performance evaluation is therefore needed to determine the actual condition of the network and identify components requiring attention. This study aims to analyze the performance of the irrigation network in the Rolak Songo Irrigation Area, particularly the Kedung Ploso Secondary Canal and Mindu Gading Secondary Canal, using the Irrigation System Performance Index (IKSI) approach based on the Regulation of the Minister of Public Works and Housing (Permen PUPR) Number 12 of 2015. The research methods employed included field observations, irrigation network condition surveys, interviews with farmers, documentation, and scoring assessments of six IKSI aspects, namely physical infrastructure, cropping productivity, supporting facilities, personnel organization, documentation, and the institutional performance of the Water User Farmers Association (P3A). The results showed that the overall condition of the irrigation network in the study area was generally good; however, several physical damages were identified, including cracked concrete lining, sedimentation, damage to irrigation structures, and the growth of wild vegetation, which affected the smooth distribution of irrigation water. Based on the IKSI assessment results, the irrigation network performance was still capable of supporting agricultural irrigation needs, but maintenance activities and rehabilitation of damaged canal sections are still required to ensure that the irrigation system functions more optimally and sustainably. The evaluation results also provide an overview of aspects requiring improvement as a basis for determining maintenance and rehabilitation priorities for damaged canal sections.

title: PENGARUH FILLER BIOKARBON DAN CARBON BLACK TIPE N990 TERHADAP SIFAT DINAMIK KOMPOSIT KARET ALAM
abstractText: Abstrak Material viskoelastik berbasis karet alam (NR) sering digunakan dalam aplikasi peredaman getaran, sehingga membutuhkan sifat dinamis dan peredaman yang memadai. Perilaku dinamis dan peredaman getaran komposit NR yang diisi dengan biokarbon turunan biomassa dan karbon hitam N990 diteliti dalam studi ini sebagai respons terhadap pengaruh jenis dan kadar pengisi. Pengisi biokarbon disintesis dari pati singkong dan kayu asam jawa melalui pirolisis, diikuti dengan penggilingan bola. Pengisi ini kemudian dimasukkan ke dalam NR dengan kadar 15, 30, dan 50 phr. Pengujian geser dinamis dan Analisis Proses Karet (RPA) diimplementasikan untuk menilai sifat dinamis komposit. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa kinerja dinamis komposit NR sangat dipengaruhi oleh jenis dan kadar pengisi. Kekakuan geser, modulus geser efektif, dan kapasitas peredaman getaran semuanya meningkat dengan peningkatan kadar pengisi. Dibandingkan dengan senyawa NR kosong, biokarbon pati singkong meningkatkan modulus geser kompleks sebesar 159% pada pemuatan 50 phr, sedangkan biokarbon kayu asam jawa meningkatkannya sebesar 109%. Karbon hitam N990 hanya menghasilkan peningkatan sebesar 62,5%. Rasio redaman yang sesuai pada 50 phr meningkat dari sekitar 0,35% untuk karbon hitam N990 menjadi 0,85% dan 1,35% untuk biokarbon pati singkong dan kayu asam jawa, masing-masing, menunjukkan peningkatan kemampuan komposit yang diisi biokarbon untuk menghilangkan energi. Selain itu, penelitian dinamis menunjukkan bahwa sementara nilai delta tangen menurun, peningkatan frekuensi meningkatkan modulus elastis, modulus viskos, dan modulus geser kompleks. Temuan ini menunjukkan bahwa pengisi biokarbon yang berasal dari biomassa dapat memberikan penguatan dan kinerja peredaman getaran yang lebih efektif daripada karbon hitam N990. Dengan demikian, biokarbon yang berasal dari kayu asam jawa dan pati singkong menunjukkan potensi sebagai alternatif parsial pengganti karbon hitam tipe N990 pada material peredam getaran berbasis karet alam yang lebih berkelanjutan.

Developing a microsimulation model of Alzheimer’s disease for the evaluation of disease modifying therapies
abstractText: Abstract Clinical trials of amyloid-targeting therapies (ATTs) for Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) showed slowing of decline in continuous cognitive and functional outcomes over eighteen months of follow-up. Existing simulation models used to extrapolate these results do not account for the distinct but correlated trajectories of cognitive and functional decline, limiting their accuracy in evaluating ATT effects on both domains. We developed an AD microsimulation model using an amyloid-positive memory clinic population that can translate slowed cognitive decline into effects on clinical functional independence stages. The model contained stages of mild cognitive impairment (MCI), community dementia, institutionalisation, and death. The transitions from MCI to dementia and from dementia to institutionalisation or death were related to Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) measurements through statistical joint models. Model validation showed that observed and predicted cumulative incidence curves overlapped for all stage transitions, indicating an accurate description of time in each stage. An untreated cohort starting with MCI had a mean duration of MCI, mild, moderate and severe community dementia, and institutionalisation of 3.3, 2.3, 1.6, 1.1, and 1.7 years, respectively, totalling 10.0 years. When ATTs slowed MMSE decline by 30% during MCI and mild dementia (community dementia with an MMSE above 20), the duration of MCI and mild dementia was prolonged by 0.4 and 1.0 years, respectively, and institutionalisation was delayed by 1.1 year. The time institutionalised remained similar. Our AD microsimulation model can translate ATT effects on cognition into effects on functional independence and can be used to assess the cost-effectiveness of new therapies.

title: Nonoperative Management of Juvenile Osteochondritis Dissecans Lesions of the Medial Femoral Condyle: Comparing Cylinder Cast, Hinged Knee Brace Locked Into Extension, and Activity Modification
abstractText: Objective: Compare nonoperative treatment options in juvenile osteochondritis dissecans (OCD) lesions of the medial femoral condyle. Design: Descriptive, retrospective cohort study. Setting: Single academic pediatric tertiary referral center. Patients (or Participants): Male/female patients ages 0 to 18 evaluated in the sports/orthopedic ambulatory setting who were found to have OCD lesions in the medial femoral condyle. Interventions (or Assessment of Risk Factors or Independent Variables): Cast immobilization, hinged knee brace locked into extension, and activity modification. Main Outcome Measures: Nonoperative treatment effectiveness between the 3 groups was evaluated by radiographic healing and symptom resolution, with failure defined as progression to surgery. Results: A total of 148 patients with 168 MFC JOCD lesions of the knee were identified. Median age was 11 years old. Patients were 65.5% male and 77% participated in sports. Sixty-two (37%) lesions were treated in a HKB locked into extension, 55 (32%) were casted in a cylinder cast, and 51 (31%) were treated with activity modification alone. Approximately 19% of HKB locked into extension, 22% of casted MFC JOCD, and 16% of activity-modified MFC JOCD lesions progressed to surgery. At 6 months, 76% of the HKB locked into extension, 71% of the cylinder cast, and 71% of the activity modification group had resolution of clinical symptoms and returned to activity. Conclusions: MFC JOCD lesions of the knee can be appropriately treated with a HKB brace locked in extension, cast, or activity modification with consistent success rates. Clinical Relevance: This study provides practical evidence regarding conservative management of MFC JOCD lesions. Level of Evidence: III.

title: Multidimensional vulnerabilities and health inequities among migrants in Tunisia: a qualitative study
abstractText: Abstract Background Migrant vulnerability is increasingly recognised as a multidimensional and dynamic condition shaped by interacting structural, social, and individual determinants. However, evidence remains largely derived from high-income countries, limiting understanding of how vulnerabilities manifest in resource-constrained transit settings. As both a transit and destination country, Tunisia provides a unique middle-income context to examine how structural barriers intersect with health equity. This study explored how multidimensional vulnerabilities are produced and experienced among migrants in Tunisia and how they influence healthcare utilisation. Methods This qualitative secondary analysis was conducted using data collected between May and December 2023 across four Tunisian cities (Tunis, Sousse, Sfax, and Medenine). Using purposive sampling, 163 participants were recruited, comprising migrants and refugees ( n = 87), migrant community leaders ( n = 33), and non-governmental organisation (NGO) staff ( n = 43). Data were collected through 33 semi-structured interviews and 16 focus group discussions conducted in participants’ preferred languages (French, Arabic, and English), with recruitment continuing until thematic saturation was achieved. Thematic analysis followed a hybrid inductive-deductive approach informed by the International Organization for Migration’s Determinants of Migrant Vulnerability (DoMV) framework. Results Vulnerability emerged as a dynamic and cumulative process driven by interacting structural, socioeconomic, and social determinants. Irregular legal status functioned as a key upstream determinant, restricting access to employment, social protection, and healthcare. Economic precarity, housing instability, family obligations, racial discrimination, gendered power asymmetries, and language barriers contributed to unmet health needs and eroded trust in public services. Participants reported a dual burden of infectious and chronic conditions alongside substantial unmet mental health needs. NGO staff corroborated these findings, highlighting systemic failures including administrative exclusion, lack of interpreter services, and the absence of culturally competent care. These intersecting vulnerabilities prompted coping strategies, including self-medication, informal support networks, and delayed healthcare utilization, which paradoxically exacerbated health risks and reinforced structural inequities. Conclusions Healthcare inequities among migrants in Tunisia are driven less by individual behaviours than by structurally embedded forms of legal and socioeconomic exclusion. Addressing upstream legal, administrative, and financial barriers is essential to promote equitable access to healthcare.

title: Influence of Online Learning Quality, Lecturer Support, and Academic Self-Efficacy on Student Engagement
abstractText: The rapid expansion of online learning in higher education has transformed the way students interact with course content, instructors, and peers, making student engagement a critical indicator of learning success. This study investigates the influence of online learning quality, lecturer support, and academic self-efficacy on student engagement in an online learning environment. Using a quantitative research design, data were collected from university students through a structured questionnaire measuring the four key constructs. The data were analyzed using multiple regression analysis to examine the direct effects of each independent variable on student engagement. The results reveal that all three variables—online learning quality, lecturer support, and academic self-efficacy—have significant positive effects on student engagement. Among these, academic self-efficacy emerged as the strongest predictor, indicating that students’ confidence in their academic abilities plays a central role in shaping their level of participation and involvement. Online learning quality also significantly contributes to engagement, emphasizing the importance of well-designed, interactive, and accessible digital learning environments. Additionally, lecturer support was found to positively influence engagement, highlighting the role of instructor presence, feedback, and communication in fostering an engaging learning experience. These findings suggest that improving both structural and psychological aspects of online education can enhance student engagement. The study contributes to the growing body of literature on online learning by providing empirical evidence on key factors that influence engagement and offers practical implications for educators and institutions aiming to optimize online learning experiences.

title: Decoding the metagenome of the precious red coral: discovery of a new spirochete lineage and carotenoid-producing bacteria
abstractText: Abstract The precious red coral Corallium rubrum is an ecologically and economically iconic Mediterranean octocoral, yet the diversity and functions of its microbiome remain a “blackbox” at the genomic scale. Here, we present a genome-resolved metagenomic analysis of C. rubrum , reconstructing 25 high-quality metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs), including 16 from wild colonies and 9 additional ones from a laboratory colony, to gain insight into the functional potential of its microbiome. Our phylogenomic analysis of the two dominant Spirochaetota symbionts reveals that one of the two symbionts represents a potential novel, previously undescribed lineage, which appears to be exclusively associated with octocoral species. Functional profiling indicates that these Spirochaetota exhibit different metabolic pathways, and are adapted to the symbiotic life, probably representing mutualistic partners for C. rubrum . Their genomes encode biosynthetic pathways of a wide range of essential amino acids and vitamins, and the capacity to ferment sugars to acetate, potentially supplementing host dietary deficiencies. We also identified an interesting symbiont, affiliated with the Qipengyuania genus, that possesses the genomic potential for the biosynthesis of the carotenoid canthaxanthin, one of the main pigments involved in the red color of C. rubrum . The other MAGs encode a wide range of metabolic pathways, especially those linked to nitrogen and sulfur transformations. Our findings suggest potential metabolic interactions between the red coral host and its microbiome. This study offers detailed taxonomic and functional characterization of newly identified octocoral symbionts, establishing a foundation for future investigations into octocoral symbiotic relationships.

title: Expression and Purification of Recombinant Duck Ovalbumin in Escherichia coli
abstractText: Ovalbumin (OVA) is a major egg white protein with a balanced amino acid profile and high digestibility, making it valuable for pharmaceutical, nutritional, and health applications. Recombinant production of ovalbumin provides a sustainable and consistent protein source that may reduce allergenic risks and offer alternatives suitable for vegetarian consumers. This study aimed to express duck ovalbumin protein in Escherichia coli as an alternative protein source. Total mRNA was isolated from duck ovarian tissue, reverse-transcribed into cDNA, and the OVA coding sequence was cloned from pGEMT-OVA into the pET28a expression vector. The constructed vector was transformed into E. coli BL21 (DE3) pLysS and E. coli (DE3) Rosetta strains. Recombinant ovalbumin was successfully expressed with an estimated molecular weight of ~45 kDa. Optimal protein production was achieved with induction using 0.25 mM isopropyl-β-D-1-thiogalactopyranoside (IPTG). Purification steps were required to isolate recombinant ovalbumin from host proteins, confirming the feasibility of microbial systems for sustainable OVA production.

title: Dinamika Hubungan Guru dan Siswa dalam Membangun Budaya Demokrasi di SMK Lingga Kencana Depok
abstractText: Teacher–student relationships outside formal lessons are part of school social life and may provide opportunities to practice democratic values. This qualitative case study examined patterns of out-of-class interaction, their relationship to democratic values, and factors shaping them at SMK Lingga Kencana Depok. Fourteen informants participated: two vice principals, a Pancasila and Civic Education teacher, a religious education teacher, and ten eleventh-grade students. Data came from in-depth interviews, non-participant observations, and documentation, analyzed using the Miles and Huberman interactive model. Findings show open communication, mutual respect, professional closeness, and opportunities for students to express opinions. Democratic values appeared through openness, respect for differences, participation, dialogue, and responsibility. Teachers’ personal approaches and the school environment supported interaction, while differences in student characteristics, limited time, and some students’ lack of confidence posed challenges. Unlike studies centered on formal lessons or structured programs, this case foregrounds everyday out-of-class interactions in vocational education. These interactions may provide a contextual space for practicing democratic values relevant to building democratic culture, but this case study does not establish a direct causal effect on its formation.

HUBUNGAN MOTIVASI BELAJAR DENGAN HASIL BELAJAR MATEMATIKA MATERI BILANGAN CACAH SISWA KELAS V SDN TRANSBANGDEP
abstractText: ABSTRACT Mathematics learning outcomes among elementary school students may vary, making it necessary to empirically examine their relationship with learning motivation, particularly in the context of whole-number content. This study aimed to analyze the relationship between learning motivation and mathematics learning outcomes in whole-number content among fifth-grade students in Class V-B at SDN Transbangdep and to identify achievement levels for each learning motivation indicator. A quantitative approach with a correlational design was employed, involving 28 students selected through total sampling. Learning motivation data were collected using a 25-item questionnaire with a four-point Likert scale, while learning outcomes were obtained from the first-semester midterm summative assessment, with a Learning Objective Achievement Criterion (KKTP) of 70. The data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, Pearson correlation, the coefficient of determination, and simple linear regression. The results showed that the mean mathematics score was 62.68, with 50% of students meeting the achievement criterion. The mean learning motivation score was 71.61%, while 53.6% of students were classified as having low or very low motivation. The correlation analysis revealed a positive and statistically significant relationship between learning motivation and mathematics learning outcomes (r = 0.407; p = 0.032), with a coefficient of determination of 16.6%. Persistence in following lessons had the highest indicator score (77.9%), whereas the ability to defend one's opinions had the lowest (66.5%). These findings indicate that learning motivation is associated with mathematics learning outcomes, although student achievement should also be understood by considering other factors. ABSTRAK Hasil belajar matematika siswa sekolah dasar dapat berbeda-beda, sehingga keterkaitannya dengan motivasi belajar perlu ditelaah secara empiris, khususnya pada materi bilangan cacah. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis hubungan motivasi belajar dengan hasil belajar matematika siswa kelas V-B SDN Transbangdep serta mengidentifikasi capaian setiap indikator motivasi belajar. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan desain korelasional yang melibatkan 28 siswa melalui teknik sampel jenuh. Data motivasi dikumpulkan menggunakan angket 25 butir berskala Likert empat tingkat, sedangkan hasil belajar diperoleh dari nilai sumatif tengah semester 1 dengan Kriteria Ketercapaian Tujuan Pembelajaran (KKTP) sebesar 70. Analisis dilakukan melalui statistik deskriptif, korelasi Pearson, koefisien determinasi, dan regresi linear sederhana. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan rata-rata nilai matematika sebesar 62,68, dengan 50% siswa mencapai ketuntasan. Rata-rata motivasi belajar tercatat sebesar 71,61%, sementara 53,6% siswa termasuk kategori motivasi rendah atau sangat rendah. Analisis korelasi menunjukkan hubungan positif dan signifikan antara motivasi belajar dan hasil belajar matematika (r = 0,407; p = 0,032), dengan koefisien determinasi sebesar 16,6%. Ketekunan mengikuti pembelajaran memperoleh capaian indikator tertinggi (77,9%), sedangkan kemampuan mempertahankan pendapat terendah (66,5%). Temuan ini menegaskan adanya keterkaitan antara motivasi dan hasil belajar, tetapi capaian matematika juga perlu dipahami dengan mempertimbangkan faktor-faktor lain.

title: Comparison of visual estimation of ventricular systolic function with quantitative echocardiographic markers in newborn infants
abstractText: Abstract Background Neonatologist-performed echocardiography (NPE) is increasingly practiced. NPE operators typically use visual estimation of systolic function and, if indicated, confirm function using quantitative echocardiographic markers. This exploratory study aims to compare the concordance between qualitative and quantitative echocardiographic markers among NPE and non-NPE operators. Methods We studied a cohort of newborn infants, undergoing routine NPE by the authors at Homerton University Hospital and Aberdeen Maternity Hospital from April 2024 to October 2024. Blinded NPE and non-NPE operators independently assessed left and right ventricular systolic function visually. We compared visual estimation with standard quantitative echocardiographic markers such as shortening fraction, Simpson’s ejection fraction and global longitudinal strain for left ventricle and tricuspid annular plane systolic excursion and fractional area change for right ventricle. We examined the concordance between visual estimation and quantitative echocardiographic markers for biventricular systolic function. Results Sixty infants with a mean (SD) gestation and birth weight of 34 (6.2) weeks and 2311 (1319) grams respectively were examined. Sensitivity testing for all echocardiographic parameters ranged from 25% to 80% whereas specificity ranged from 38% to 78%. Sensitivity increased with worsening grades of LV dysfunction defined using shortening fraction. While concordance between NPE and non-NPE operator was generally limited across most echocardiographic parameters, test-retest reliability was acceptable for several quantitative measures, including Simpson’s ejection fraction, global longitudinal strain and right ventricular fractional area change. Conclusion Visual estimation may be a useful bedside tool for detecting severe ventricular dysfunction in newborn infants; however; quantitative echocardiographic measures are likely to improve the assessment of mild to moderate dysfunction. Further studies should confirm these findings in a larger cohort with a higher representation of infants with ventricular dysfunction.

title: Integrating network pharmacology, genetically informed multi-omics and granulosa-cell experiments identifies dauricine and oleanolic acid as candidate CASP3-modulating compounds of Zhi-Bai-Di-Huang-Wan in female pubertal timing
Analisis Spasial Hubungan Perubahan Tutupan Lahan Akibat Deforestasi Terhadap Bahaya Longsor di Kecamatan Malalak
abstractText: Perubahan tutupan lahan akibat deforestasi di wilayah hulu dan pegunungan merupakan parameter kritis yang memicu peningkatan bencana tanah longsor. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk: 1) menganalisis luas deforestasi pada periode 2016, 2020, dan 2025; 2) memetakan zona bahaya longsor; dan 3) menganalisis hubungan spasial antara deforestasi dan bahaya longsor di Kecamatan Malalak. Metode yang digunakan adalah penginderaan jauh melalui Google Earth Engine (GEE) untuk analisis deforestasi, serta Weighted Overlay pada Sistem Informasi Geografis (SIG) untuk pemodelan bahaya longsor. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan luas deforestasi mengalami perubahan yang signifikan, yaitu 20,92 ha (2016), 29,95 ha (2020), dan 11,68 ha (2025). Hasil overlay menunjukkan deforestasi selalu terkonsentrasi pada zona bahaya sedang, tinggi, dan sangat tinggi, serta tidak ditemukan pada zona bahaya rendah. Lonjakan deforestasi pada zona sangat tinggi tahun 2020 (1,92 ha) sejalan dengan perluasan zona bahaya sangat tinggi (559,27 ha menjadi 1382,97 ha). Meskipun luas deforestasi menurun pada 2025, proporsinya pada zona sangat tinggi justru meningkat tajam menjadi 2,20 ha. Berdasarkan kedua temuan ini, pengendalian alih fungsi lahan pada zona bahaya tinggi dan sangat tinggi ditetapkan sebagai prioritas utama mitigasi. Hasil penelitian diharapkan dapat mendukung kebijakan pengendalian alih fungsi lahan, perencanaan tata ruang berbasis mitigasi bencana, serta menjaga kelestarian ekosistem di kawasan hulu.

title: Impact of Geological–Geophysical Data Integration on Coal Tonnage and Stripping Ratio Estimation in an Open Pit Coal Mine
abstractText: Open pit coal plans rely on geological models built from widely spaced drill holes, so errors in seam continuity pass directly into tonnage and stripping ratio forecasts. This study quantifies how integrating infill drilling and electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) with existing drill hole data changes the seam model, and the coal tonnage, overburden volume and stripping ratio derived from it, within an unchanged pit boundary. At a reopened pit in Ogan Komering Ulu, South Sumatra, the initial model predicted 34,518.86 t of coal for the first 2.84 ha excavated, whereas truck counts recorded 2,615.6 t. Two infill holes and four Wenner–Schlumberger ERT lines (600 m in total) were interpreted with the existing drill holes, Seams X and Y were remodelled, and volumes were recalculated within the same 22.41 ha boundary. The decisive new information was that the southern infill hole did not intersect Seam Y and that the borehole-calibrated coal response (above 5,000 Ωm) was continuous in the west but faded towards the south and southeast. Seam roofs shifted by −11 to +6 m, and the seams were terminated where both data sets indicated their absence. Estimated coal therefore fell by 34.50% (490,346.96 t, from 1,421,125.56 t to 930,778.60 t), overburden rose by 10.11%, and the stripping ratio increased from 2.48 to 4.17 BCM/t. These changes quantify the effect of the revised seam geometry; support for the revised model comes separately, from its agreement with the infill drilling and with what excavation has exposed. Because the ERT inversions have high RMS errors and only two infill holes were available, the revised estimates are provisional, and the early-mining shortfall cannot be attributed to the initial model alone. For open pit planning, the case shows that a low-cost geophysical check tied to drill holes can change the economics of a short-term pit design before most of it is excavated.

title: How natural disaster cues trigger interest in capability-oriented self-improvement products: the mediating mechanism of self-protection motivation
abstractText: Purpose This research investigates how natural disaster cues influence consumer preferences for capability-oriented self-improvement products. Specifically, it examines the mediating role of self-protection motivation and the moderating effect of self-mastery in this relationship. Design/methodology/approach Three experimental studies were conducted with different manipulations of natural disaster cues (i.e. guided recall tasks, news articles paired with photographs and image stimuli) and diverse capability-oriented self-improvement products (i.e. a wealth management app, a learning website and an e-book titled communication skills). Findings Results across three studies demonstrate that exposure to natural disaster cues significantly increases preferences for capability-oriented self-improvement products. This effect is mediated by self-protection motivation. Furthermore, self-mastery moderates this mediating pathway: the indirect effect is stronger among consumers with high self-mastery than those with low self-mastery. Originality/value First, we extend disaster research by examining the impact of disaster cues on capability-oriented self-improvement product preferences. Second, we identify natural disaster cues as a new precursor of self-improvement product preferences. Third, beyond its established role in harm avoidance, we show self-protection motivation also drives proactive self-improvement. Fourth, we introduce self-mastery into consumer research on natural disaster cues.

title: 文化学理论体系构建的开创性研究
abstractText: 杜染的中方和蒙方博士生导师以及中外学者们为杜染著《文化现代性建构论》作序言五篇。哲格玛认为杜染的研究成果“可以说是文化学理论研究的贡献，具有较高的学术价值，这对蒙古国研究文化学理论及文化学学科建设也是一个重要参照。”贺西格、刘亚丛认为该著作是一个开创性的研究成果，提出了独创性的文化理论，“这些研究在国际上具有一定的开拓性，是需要进一步深入研究的领域，具有学术意义和世界意义。”段宝林认为《文化现代性建构论》是一项原创性的文化理论研究成果，构建了一个非常宏大的学术体系，“这些理论在其他的著作中是很难找到的，这是杜染的独创。”周星认为，杜染所达成的对于“文化建构主义”的认知，在很多地方，其实也和民俗学、文化人类学、文化社会学、社会学的“文化研究”以及文化政治学等领域的学术研究所揭示的“文化”得以生成、存续、动态变迁和再生产的机制，基本上是殊途而同归的。李修建指出杜染立足马克思主义的理论和观点，提出了一系列具有原创意义的概念、范畴或命题，提出一套理论体系，值得鼓掌赞叹。

title: GRADE-AWARE MULTI-TARGET MACHINE LEARNING OF STEEL MECHANICAL PROPERTIES: ENSEMBLE, ANN, AND SELF-ATTENTION TRANSFORMER MODELS UNDER UNSEEN-GRADE SHIFT
abstractText: Predicting steel mechanical properties from heterogeneous chemistry and heat-treatment metadata is a domain-transfer problem because repeated observations are hierarchically clustered by grade and property reporting is incomplete. This study develops a leakage-resistant multi-target learning framework using 1,360 Steel Bench records representing 562 unique grades, 12 chemistry and processing descriptors, and five responses: tensile strength, yield strength, elongation, reduction of area, and impact energy. Missing targets are not imputed. Numeric imputation, standardization, and categorical encoding g are fitted within each training fold, while neural models use a masked multi-response objective. Twelve conventional regressors are benchmarked against a 256-128-64 artificial neural network and a two-block, four-head self-attention Transformer. Model selection uses three repeats of five-fold grade-grouped cross-validation, followed by a completely grade-disjoint locked test. Extra Trees provides strong cross-target development performance, with grouped-cross-validation R² values of approximately 0.572, 0.462, 0.558, 0.366, and 0.354 for tensile strength, yield strength, elongation, reduction of area, and impact energy, respectively, while Gradient Boosting leads the development ranking for elongation and impact energy. On the locked unseen-grade test, elongation remains transferable (R² = 0.646) and impact energy retains moderate skill (R² = 0.370), whereas tensile strength, yield strength, and reduction of area exhibit negative R². Distribution-shift and descriptor-ablation analyses show that chemistry redistribution, missingness shift, and incomplete process-state descriptors constrain transfer more strongly than nominal model complexity.

SUARA RAKYAT ADALAH SUARA TUHAN ANALISIS ALKITAB TENTANG PEMIMPIN SEBAGAI PILIHAN ALLAH : FENOMENA KORUPSI DI INDONESIA
abstractText: Penelitian ini di dorong oleh sebuah pertanyaan apakah pemimpin berasal dari Allah. Hal ini untuk melihat isu korupsi di Indonesia seringkali terjadi dalam kalangan pemerintahan. Fenomone korupsi sering terjadi, namun hanya di lihat dari aspek politik, sosial dan satutus ekonomi, namun minim bentuk-bentuk ini dari aspek keagamaan salah satunya adalah Kekristenan. Alkitab mendispkripsikan model kepemimpinan, pemerintah bahkan isitilah rakyat secara implisit maupun eksplisit di narasikan dalam Alkitab. Penelitian menggunakan kualitatif dengan studi literatur melalui buku-buku, jurnal yang relevan sesuai dengan topik. Kemudian penelitian melakukan pendekatan kontekstual melaui analisis ayat-ayat Alkitab yang relevan, dan tokoh-tokoh politik yang memiliki latar belakang kekristenan dalam memahami konteks politik. Kedua model pendekatan ini dilakukan melalui analisis tematik kontekstual sehingga menghasilkan nilai-nilai pemimpin yang relevan dengan budaya Indonesia. Penelitian ini menemukan bahwa konsep vox populi, vox Dei tidak berarti bahwa setiap keputusan mayoritas atau pemimpin yang terpilih secara demokratis otomatis merupakan kehendak Allah. Alkitab menegaskan bahwa pemimpin yang dipilih atau diizinkan Allah tetap harus tunduk pada prinsip keadilan, integritas, dan ketaatan kepada-Nya. Oleh karena itu, legitimasi politik berbeda dengan legitimasi moral dan ilahi. Ketika pemimpin menyalahgunakan kekuasaan melalui korupsi, ia telah menyimpang dari mandat Allah dan kehilangan legitimasi moralnya. Dengan demikian, gereja memiliki tanggung jawab profetis untuk mengkritisi kekuasaan yang koruptif, membangun kesadaran etis masyarakat, serta menegaskan bahwa kekuasaan adalah amanat yang harus dipertanggungjawabkan kepada Allah dan publik.

title: Analisis Tingkat Kerawanan Longsor di Area Terbangun di Kelurahan Kuranji
abstractText: Tanah longsor merupakan salah satu bencana yang berpotensi menimbulkan kerusakan lingkungan, infrastruktur, dan korban jiwa. Kelurahan Kuranji, Kota Padang, memiliki kondisi topografi berbukit dengan perkembangan area terbangun yang cukup pesat sehingga berpotensi meningkatkan risiko longsor. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk 1) Menganalisis tingkat kerawanan longsor di Kelurahan kuranji ; dan 2) Menganalisis sebaran area terbangun pada setiap kelas kerawanan di Kelurahan Kuranji. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan analisis spasial berbasis Sistem Informasi Geografis (SIG). Metode Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) digunakan untuk menentukan bobot lima parameter, yaitu kemiringan lereng, curah hujan, geologi, jenis tanah, dan penggunaan lahan. Selanjutnya dilakukan proses overlay untuk menghasilkan peta kerawanan longsor serta identifikasi area terbangun pada setiap kelas kerawanan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa tingkat kerawanan longsor di Kelurahan Kuranji terbagi menjadi tiga kelas, yaitu kerawanan rendah seluas 1.080,092 Ha (48,386%), kerawanan sedang seluas 889,023 Ha (39,827%), dan kerawanan tinggi seluas 263,091 Ha (11,787%). Untuk area terbangun tersebar pada seluruh kelas kerawanan, namun didominasi oleh kelas kerawanan rendah. Keberadaan area terbangun pada kelas kerawanan sedang dan tinggi menunjukkan perlunya perhatian dalam perencanaan tata ruang dan upaya mitigasi bencana guna mengurangi potensi risiko longsor di wilayah penelitian.

title: Symmetric mode multiplexing waveguide switch based on optical phase change material
abstractText: We propose a 2×6 mode-multiplexing silicon optical waveguide switch leveraging the low-loss phase-change material Ge2Sb2Se4Te1. The device architecture comprises a 2×2 symmetric switch cascaded with two 1×3 reconfigurable mode switches. The design is analyzed using coupled mode and supermode theories, with propagation characteristics verified via three-dimensional finite-difference time-domain simulations. Our results demonstrate robust performance across the optical communication C-band. At 1550 nm, the 2×2 switching element exhibits a high extinction ratio (ER) of 37 dB and a minimal insertion loss (IL) of 0.03 dB. The 1×3 components facilitate efficient mode conversion from TE0 to TE1 and TE2, yielding an ER and IL of 17.2 and 0.15 dB for the former and 16.19 and 0.71 dB for the latter. The integrated 2×6 switch enables both time division and reconfigurable mode-multiplexing, maintaining an ER>12.5 dB and IL<1.8 dB across all 12 operational channels. Furthermore, through geometric optimization, the device effectively isolates and selects modes from mixed transverse electric (TE) or transverse magnetic (TM) inputs. This multi-channel waveguide switch significantly enhances the versatility of reconfigurable, phase-change-material-based multiplexing for integrated photonic circuits.

title: Analisis Kemampuan Numerasi Siswa Sekolah Menengah Atas pada Ujian Akhir Sekolah
abstractText: Abstract: This study aims to determine the numeracy skills of twelfth-grade students at SMAN 2 Palopo in the areas of numbers, geometry and measurement, algebra, as well as data and uncertainty. This study employed a descriptive quantitative method with a sample of 124 students. The results showed that students’ numeracy skills in numbers reached 32.49%, geometry and measurement 36.39%, and algebra 37.34%, all of which were categorized as low. Meanwhile, numeracy skills in data and uncertainty reached 44.6%, which was categorized as moderate. The low numeracy skills indicate that some students still experience difficulties in understanding basic mathematical concepts and applying them in problem-solving. However, in the area of data and uncertainty, students tended to understand the material more easily because it is more contextual and closely related to daily life. Abstrak: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui kemampuan numerasi siswa kelas XII di SMAN 2 Palopo pada konten bilangan, geometri dan pengukuran, aljabar, serta data dan ketidakpastian. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode kuantitatif deskriptif dengan sampel sebanyak 124 siswa. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa kemampuan numerasi pada konten bilangan sebesar 32,49%, geometri dan pengukuran 36,39%, serta aljabar 37,34% yang seluruhnya berada pada kategori rendah. Sementara itu, kemampuan numerasi pada konten data dan ketidakpastian sebesar 44,6% berada pada kategori sedang. Rendahnya kemampuan numerasi menunjukkan bahwa sebagian siswa masih mengalami kesulitan dalam memahami konsep dasar matematika dan penerapannya dalam pemecahan masalah. Namun, pada konten data dan ketidakpastian, siswa cenderung lebih mudah memahami materi karena lebih kontekstual dan dekat dengan kehidupan sehari-hari.

title: Implementation of LMS-Based Interactive Media for Islamic Religious Education Evaluation in Grade VII at SMP Negeri 1 Barebbo
abstractText: This study describes the implementation of interactive learning media based on a Learning Management System (LMS) for evaluating Islamic Religious Education (PAI) in Grade VII at SMP Negeri 1 Barebbo, the types of evaluation applied, and the obstacles faced by the teacher and students. Using a descriptive qualitative design, the study collected data from 11 May to 11 June 2026 through non-participant observation, semi-structured interviews with one PAI teacher and four Grade VII.4 students, and documentation. The data were analysed through collection, reduction, display, and conclusion drawing, and were checked through source and technique triangulation. The teacher used Quizizz integrated with Google Classroom through planning, implementation, and use of results, and both the teacher and the students responded positively. Formative and summative evaluations were both administered and differed in purpose rather than in procedure. The main obstacles were an unstable internet connection and students’ distraction by other phone applications, which the teacher addressed through assistance, hotspot provision, and supervision. The findings imply that the teacher’s role remains decisive in digital evaluation and that schools need to strengthen network facilities. The study is limited to one school, one class, and one teacher, and it did not analyse students’ scores.

title: Inventory And Logistics Information System Architecture Based On Web Using Agile Development Method
abstractText: PT. Mekanikatama Jaya Makmur still manages its inventory manually using a general ledger, which may lead to inventory data discrepancies, recording errors, and delays in report preparation. This study aims to develop a web-based Inventory Information System to support the structured management of fixed assets and consumable supplies. The method used in this study is Agile Development, with data collection techniques including observation, interviews, and literature review. The developed system provides features for managing fixed assets, item data, incoming goods, outgoing goods, inventory reports, and user access rights. The results of the study include the implementation of a web-based inventory information system that provides integrated inventory recording, management, and reporting functions. System testing showed that the developed features could be used in accordance with the identified inventory management requirements. The developed system can be used as a supporting tool for managing fixed assets and consumable supplies at PT. Mekanikatama Jaya Makmur.

title: Antecedents of Green Food Purchase Intention: The Mediating Role of Health Consciousness and Attitude – Evidence from Jabodetabek
abstractText: This study examines the factors influencing consumers’ intention to purchase green food using the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB) as the main conceptual framework. Increasing environmental problems, food safety concerns, and unhealthy eating patterns have raised public interest in green food consumption. However, consumers’ purchase intention toward green food remains relatively low in Indonesia, making it important to understand the underlying psychological factors. The analyzed factors include environmental concern, food safety consciousness, health consciousness, and attitude toward green food, with health consciousness and attitude toward green food acting as mediating variables. This study employed a quantitative causal research design using an online questionnaire survey administered to 275 respondents in the Jabodetabek area who were familiar with green food products. Data were analyzed using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) to test direct and indirect relationships among the variables. The results show that environmental concern, food safety consciousness, and health consciousness have significant positive effects on green food purchase intention. Environmental concern and food safety consciousness also significantly increase health consciousness, which leads to a more positive attitude toward green food. Attitude toward green food plays an important mediating role in strengthening purchase intention. These findings indicate that green food purchase intention is formed through a structured psychological process in which health awareness and positive attitudes connect consumers’ concerns to buying intention. This study contributes to the sustainable consumption literature and provides practical insights for promoting green food consumption in Indonesia.

Artificial intelligence and research integrity in reproductive medicine: reproducibility, transparency, accountability, and responsible translation
abstractText: Abstract Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being investigated across reproductive medicine, including semen analysis, sperm detection and selection, oocyte and embryo assessment, prediction of assisted reproductive technology outcomes, clinical decision support, and integration of multi-omics data. Large language models and generative AI are also emerging as tools for scientific writing, education, documentation, and research support. This review critically examines the current applications, clinical readiness, and research-integrity implications of AI in reproductive medicine. Although many models demonstrate promising performance in classification, ranking, or outcome prediction, the available evidence remains predominantly retrospective, task-specific, and derived from single-center or internally validated datasets. High technical performance does not necessarily translate into improved cumulative live birth, patient safety, cost-effectiveness, workflow efficiency, or equitable clinical outcomes. Important barriers include dataset heterogeneity, limited external and prospective validation, inadequate calibration assessment, data leakage, algorithmic bias, limited interpretability, privacy and cybersecurity risks, and vulnerability to performance drift. Generative AI introduces additional concerns, including fabricated references, inaccurate scientific summaries, undisclosed contributions, confidentiality breaches, and the generation or alteration of images that may be misrepresented as empirical evidence. Responsible translation therefore requires transparent reporting, independent temporal and geographic validation, subgroup and fairness analyses, prospective clinical-impact evaluation, preservation of data and model provenance, and continuous post-deployment surveillance. Current international guidance further emphasizes that AI systems cannot qualify as authors and that accountable human researchers must verify generated content and disclose material AI use. AI should presently be regarded as an assistive technology that augments, rather than replaces, embryologists, clinicians, and researchers. Future progress will depend on multicenter prospective studies using patient-important outcomes, design-appropriate reporting frameworks, risk-based regulatory oversight, and clearly defined human accountability throughout the AI lifecycle.

title: Local pollution challenges in the global energy transition: air quality near hydrometallurgical and pyrometallurgical plants in the Congolese Copperbelt
abstractText: Abstract The Congolese Copperbelt is a major source of copper and cobalt for the global energy transition, but mineral processing creates substantial and poorly documented local air-pollution risks. This study presents a multi-pollutant, multi-directional, and seasonally resolved assessment of ambient air quality around one hydrometallurgical plant in Kakanda and one pyrometallurgical plant in Lubumbashi. We monitored SO₂, NO₂, PM 10 , PM 2.5 , total suspended particles (TSP), Cu, and Pb during four campaigns in 2022, along with meteorological conditions and Air Quality Index (AQI) calculations. Most mean concentrations were below Congolese regulatory limits, although SO₂, Cu, and Pb showed episodic exceedances. By contrast, SO₂, NO₂, PM 10 , and PM 2.5 frequently exceeded the 2021 WHO health-based guidelines. Raw peak concentrations reached 6.0 mg/m 3 for SO₂ in the northern sector of the hydrometallurgical site and 5.0 mg/m 3 for NO₂ in the northern sector of the pyrometallurgical site. SO₂ dominated at the hydrometallurgical site, whereas NO₂ dominated at the pyrometallurgical site, consistent with the respective process profiles. The most severe conditions occurred in July, at the peak of the dry season, when the eastern sectors reached AQI values of 373.20 (Hazardous; SO₂-driven) at the hydrometallurgical site and 239.93 (Very Unhealthy; NO₂-driven) at the pyrometallurgical site. Lower relative humidity was associated with higher gaseous-pollutant concentrations, while stronger winds transported plumes toward northern and eastern sectors. These findings indicate that compliance with current Congolese limits does not necessarily provide health protection and support tighter standards, continuous monitoring, and process-specific emission controls. The local costs of the global energy transition are varied and are disproportionately borne by communities adjacent to mineral extraction and processing facilities.

title: Meta-Sintesis Pancasila Sebagai Ideologi atau Pemikiran Filosofis: Sebuah Tinjauan Kritis dalam Perspektif Komunikasi
abstractText: Pancasila is often debated as either an ideology or a philosophical system of thought, while a gap between its values and everyday practice persists. This study aims to quantitatively synthesize the strength of the relationship between understanding and practicing Pancasila values and citizen behavior, such as tolerance and radical attitudes. It uses Koento Wibisono's dimensions of ideology (belief, myth, loyalty) and the three philosophical principles (ontology, epistemology, axiology) as its framework, with the way values are delivered treated as a moderator. The study was designed as a meta-analysis using a random-effects model and Fisher's z transformation. A search of the Garuda and Google Scholar databases for publications from 1996 to 2026 yielded twenty articles as an initial corpus. All were conceptual, normative, or qualitative, so effect sizes could not yet be pooled and the three hypotheses could not be tested statistically. A thematic synthesis shows that ideology and philosophy are understood as a unity, that Pancasila values are hierarchical, and that their practice remains suboptimal, while rote-based education leaves little lasting impression. The corpus only hints at a positive relationship between internalizing Pancasila and tolerance. This study contributes a coding scheme for future research and recommends strengthening programs that emphasize role modeling, character education, and value delivery suited to technological developments.

Severe environmental disturbances compromise ecological thresholds in aquatic environments
abstractText: Abstract Large-scale disturbances can profoundly alter aquatic ecosystems by modifying water chemistry, sediment dynamics, and biodiversity across connected freshwater and marine environments. The 2015 Fundão Dam collapse in Brazil provides an unprecedented context to evaluate how multiple aquatic communities respond to intense and prolonged contamination, revealing key mechanisms of community reorganization under chronic anthropogenic impacts. By a multi-taxa monitoring dataset collected from 62 freshwater and marine sites, we analyzed how different communities, comprising phytoplankton, zooplankton, macroinvertebrates, and fish, responded along a gradient of mining tailing exposure. Applying threshold indicator taxa analysis (TITAN), we identified critical environmental variables, capturing tipping points for positive and negative biotic responses to tailing-related environmental gradients. Our results showed that mining-related contaminants, combined with hydrogeochemical alterations triggered by the dam collapse, have driven long-term changes in biodiversity, reshaping ecosystem functioning. The same stressors that caused widespread negative responses in community structure also promoted localized increases in opportunistic, mainly planktonic taxa, indicating a multidirectional community reorganization. In general, small increases in metals and hydrogeochemical alterations (such as turbidity up to 17 NTU in riverine systems and 2 NTU in the marine sites), resulting from the dam collapse have driven persistent changes in biodiversity, ultimately reshaping ecosystem functioning. Integrating community-level thresholds should represent a critical approach to improve the detection of regime shifts and to support the development of habitat-specific recovery strategies for riverine and marine ecosystems affected by mining disturbances.

title: Systematic framework for ARIMA and SARIMA model selection using multiple error metrics: An application to export forecasting
abstractText: This study proposes a systematic and practical framework for selecting autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA) and seasonal autoregressive integrated moving average (SARIMA) forecasting models based on multiple error evaluation metrics, including root mean square error (RMSE), mean absolute percentage error (MAPE), and mean absolute error (MAE). In practical forecasting applications, different error metrics often produce conflicting model selection outcomes, resulting in uncertainty in decision-making. Accordingly, this study introduces a percentage-based consistency evaluation approach to identify the most reliable forecasting model across multiple datasets. This study proposes a systematic framework for ARIMA and SARIMA model selection that integrates multiple forecasting error metrics to address conflicting model rankings and improve the consistency of model-selection decisions. This framework is applied to Thailand’s export value data, consisting of 69 monthly observations across 12 datasets derived from major industrial product groups (HS-84, HS-85, and HS-87) and key trading partners, including China, Japan, and South Korea. Results indicate that ARIMA(1,2,1) achieves the highest level of consistency across error metrics, with 83.33% under RMSE and 75% under MAPE and MAE. In terms of seasonal models, SARIMA (2,2,2)(2,0,0)₁₂ demonstrates the best overall performance. The findings confirm that the choice of error metrics can significantly influence forecasting outcomes. The proposed consistency-based framework reduces model selection conflicts and enhances the reliability of decision-making. This approach provides practical guidance for forecasting applications in economic planning, industrial systems, and export management.

Cardiometabolic multimorbidity and mortality in calcific aortic valve stenosis: the ARISTOTLE cohort study
abstractText: Abstract Background Cardiometabolic multimorbidity (CMM), defined as the coexistence of two or more cardiometabolic diseases (CMDs), is highly prevalent in patients with calcific aortic valve stenosis (CAVS). However, its association with mortality in this population remains poorly characterized. Methods This retrospective cohort study analyzed 1175 adults with echocardiographically confirmed CAVS from the ARISTOTLE (Aortic valve diseases RISk facTOr assessmenT and prognosis modeL construction) registry. Participants were stratified by baseline CMD count into pre-specified primary exposure groups: CMM0 (no CMD), CMM1 (one CMD), and CMM2–3 (≥ 2 CMDs). CMDs included type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), coronary heart disease (CHD), and ischemic stroke. Cause-specific Cox proportional-hazards models were applied; non-cardiovascular deaths were treated as censoring events for cardiovascular mortality analyses. Fine–Gray competing-risk models were constructed, with non-cardiovascular death set as the competing event. Formal interaction testing with Bonferroni correction was conducted for pre-defined subgroup analyses. Exploratory four-category CMD stratification and analyses of distinct CMD combinations were presented in supplementary materials. Results During a median follow-up of 3.23 years, 329 all-cause deaths and 179 cardiovascular deaths occurred. Mortality risk tended to increase with higher cardiometabolic multimorbidity burden. In the fully adjusted model, participants with ≥ 2 CMDs showed higher risk of all-cause mortality (HR 1.74, 95% CI 1.23–2.48; P = 0.002) and cardiovascular mortality (HR 2.24, 95% CI 1.39–3.61; P < 0.001), compared with patients without CMD. Each incremental rise in CMD count was associated with 30% higher all-cause death risk (HR 1.30, 95% CI 1.10–1.53, P = 0.002) and 47% higher cardiovascular death risk (HR 1.47, 95% CI 1.18–1.84, P < 0.001). Fine–Gray competing-risk analyses yielded consistent findings (subdistribution HR 2.07, 95% CI 1.30–3.28, P = 0.002 for CMM2–3 versus CMM0). Associations between CMD burden and mortality were directionally uniform across most predefined subgroups; no statistically significant interaction remained after Bonferroni correction for multiple comparisons. Conclusions Among patients with calcific aortic valve stenosis, higher cumulative cardiometabolic multimorbidity burden was independently associated with elevated all‑cause and cardiovascular mortality. These observational findings suggest that assessment of cumulative cardiometabolic comorbidity burden may add prognostic context for patients with CAVS.
